This ensures that the PA output power is greater than 40 dBm, the power-added efficiency (PAE) is greater than 60%, and the gain is greater than 10 dB within the 1–3 GHz range.

articleTitle: A High Temperature Resistant Broadband Metamaterial Absorber
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Based on high temperature resistant silicon dioxide(SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) and silicon carbide(SiC) materials, a high temperature resistant broadband meta material absorber was designed in this paper. The absorber consists of two layers of SiC pattern, three layers of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{SiO}_{2}$</tex> transmission medium, and a bottom layer of low resistance SiC thin film reflection layer. The simulation results show that the absorption rate of the absorber exceeds 90% in the frequency range of 3.46-18.37GHz, and the relative absorption bandwidth is 136.6%. The absorber device also has the characteristics of low process implementation difficulty, polarization insensitivity, and wide-angle absorption. Therefore, it has potential application value in fields such as radar imaging, stealth, and communication technology.

articleTitle: Capacity Characterization for Binary RIS Aided MIMO Communication System Based on An Electromagnetic Scattering Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) aided communication system has demonstrated its efficacy in enhancing information transmission efficiency without inducing excessive energy losses and costs. Analyzing the channel characteristics of reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) based communication systems using a rigorous electromagnetic model is crucial for the expedited development of modern communication modes such as high-frequency communication and near-field communication. Such analysis expectedly reveals potential communication degrees of freedom, which have yet to be widely explored. In this article, an electromagnetic model based approach is employed to estimate the received signal and channel matrix for a digital coded metasurface-aided MIMO communication system. The channel capacity of the system under random fixed RIS and controllable RIS is analyzed, respectively. The effect of random RIS is estimated by averaging the capacity under each fixed RIS. On the other hand, the channel capacity of the controllable RIS-aided system is obtained by traversing each RIS state and selecting the highest value. Our calculation results obtained at different RIS locations highlight that RIS improves the overall channel capacity of the original system, with particularly greater improvement observed in locations closer to the transceiver center.

articleTitle: A Vertical Polarized Electromagnetic Pulse Simulator for HEMP Scaled Model Test
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A test system consists of a vertical polarized electromagnetic pulse simulator and corresponding wideband electronic field sensor is built for scaled model high-altitude electromagnetic pulse (HEMP) test. Numerical simulation and measurement results of the field generated by the simulator are compared to verify the capability of the system. Possible applications of the system are analyzed based on the theoretical basis.

articleTitle: Parametric Multiphysics Modeling Using Space Mapping for Diaphragm Waveguide Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Multiphysics coupling effect in waveguide filter is increasingly obvious with the operating frequency going up to THz by degrees. This paper uses a novel parametric modeling method combining space mapping technique and neuro-transfer function to accelerate Multiphysics modeling of microwave components by electromagnetic single physics simulation. This proposed method had the computational efficiency of EM single physics simulation and accurate multiphysic response of multiphysics simulation combined. Finally this method is applied to a 83GHz E-plane waveguide filter to figuratively demonstrate its process.

articleTitle: A Stochastic Channel Model for IRS-Enhanced Vehicle-to-Vehicle Communications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper proposes a non-stationary three-dimensional (3D) geometry-based stochastic model (GBSM) for a beyond fifth generation (B5G) vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) system that uses an intelligent reflecting surface (IRS) and 3D uniform linear array (ULA) at transceiver to improve the spectrum and energy efficiency of radio communications. In order to investigate the effects of the vehicle traffic-density (VTD) on channel characteristics in B5G V2V massive MIMO environment, the proposed model first distinguishes dynamic clusters from static clusters based on vehicle movement. A novel method is also proposed to replicate the channel's non-stationarity in the space, time, and frequency domains. In the novel approach, status was kept up to date using the birth-death process after producing static/dynamic correlated clusters using improved K-Mean and Calinski-Harabasz clustering algorithms. The space, time, and frequency-based correlation functions and the doppler power spectrum-density (DPSD) are generated and thoroughly examined as significant channel stochastic characteristics. The main finding of this paper is that by changing the phase-shifts of IRS, Doppler and multipath effects in radio propagation environment can be successfully alleviated or avoided.

articleTitle: Stochastic Analysis of a Nonuniform Star-Quad Cable with Deformed Structure Along Its Line
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A stochastic analysis is performed to investigate the electromagnetic wave coupling with a deformed star-quad cable. It is considered that the star-quad cable is not uniform because the distances between its wires can vary progressively along its line due to any external mechanical stresses. Therefore, the parametric equations of the star-quad cable are generalized by introducing a variable angle along the cable line. Consequently, the random fluctuations of the induced differential-mode current due to the random deformations along the star-quad cable line are studied. It is found that the star-quad cable with fillers has better performance in reducing the external coupling as compared to the one without fillers because the fillers can preserve a balanced geometry along the star-quad cable line.

articleTitle: Effects of 915 MHz Microwave Radiation on the Temperature Distribution in the Human Body
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The bioeffects of the electromagnetic fields of microwave on the human body are a matter of concern. In this paper, the influence of 915MHz microwave radiation on the temperature distribution in the human body was studied. The temperature increases inside the human body due to exposure to 915 MHZ microwave were analyzed by the finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method. The results showed that the peak temperature increases occur in the skin, head and central part tissues of the human body, and where the temperature fluctuations are more obvious.

articleTitle: An HC and Deep MIM Enhanced PINN SciML Algorithm for the Transient Thermal Analysis of 3-D Packages of Integrated Circuits
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this work, a physics-informed neural network (PINN) scientific machine learning (SciML) algorithm combined with the hard constraint (HC) and the deep mixed residual method (MIM) is proposed for solving transient thermal problems of 3-D Packages of Integrated Circuits (ICs). By incorporating the physics information of heat transfer into the neural network, the network can be trained to accurately predict the temperature changes over the time. In addition, hard constraints are used to learn initial conditions, while deep mixed residual methods are applied to reduce the order of the derivations, resulting in an improved accuracy and lower training complexity. To validate the proposed method, a representative 3-D package of a integrated circuit (IC) is investigated in this work.

articleTitle: Design of 20GHz Wide Tuning Range LC-VCO in 55-nm CMOS
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a 20GHz wideband, high linearity and low phase noise voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO) is achieved. A different bias voltages variable capacitor array improved frequency modulation linearity,effectively. Adopting the tail current source noise filtering technique, the level of phase noise is significantly reduced. The designed VCO has been implemented in 55nm RF CMOS process, operates at a supply voltage of 1V, and exhibits an average power consumption of 24.8mW excluding output driving buffers. Post-simulation results demonstrate that the VCO obtains a tuning range from 18.84 to 21.58GHz, which achieves a low phase noise of -110.58dBc/Hz at 1MHz offset from a 20GHz carrier. The core chip occupies an area of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$640\mu \mathrm{m}\times 420\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex>.

articleTitle: Cylindrical Antenna System for Cell Fixation and Coverage Extension in HAPS
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: High-altitude platform stations (HAPS) have attracted a great deal of attention as a promising candidate for the coverage extension for 6G. However, the coverage achieved by the planar array is limited to a circular area with a radius around tens of kilometers. On the other hand, for a multi-cell configuration in HAPS, frequent switches among coverage areas due to the platform movement is another problem that needs to be solved. In this paper, we proposed a cylindrical multiple input multiple output(MIMO) system for achieving ultrawide coverage and cell fixation in HAPS. In a case where an area with a radius of 50 km is considered, the simulated results show that the proposed system improves signal-to-interference plus-noise ratio by about 1dB at the boundary of the area in comparison to the conventional massive MIMO(mMIMO) using the planar array. In addition, the proposed antenna system can maintain stable coverage in a multicell configuration.

articleTitle: Efficient Simulation of Large Scale Metasurfaces Accelerated by Characteristic Subdomain Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In order to perform simulation on metasurfaces with quasi-periodic structures efficiently, a new technique based on hybrid finite element-boundary element-domain decomposition method (FEM-BEM-DDM) is proposed to reduce computation resources consumed during processing. Due to the geometric repetition existing in these models, the mesh of the entire array is expanded from limited sets of characteristic arrays, which generated by units at specific positions of the original array. With this technique, repetitive pre-processing, matrix filling and matrix-vector multiplication can be saved. The accuracy of the proposed method is validated through comparing with commercial software, and the results are in good accordance. And the new technique reduced approximately 75% memory requirement of the traditional FEM-BEM-DDM, which ensures efficient simulation on arrays with quasi-periodic structures.

articleTitle: Investigation on Electromagnetic Scattering of Moving Target by the Improved SBR Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In recent years, with the instant development of radar detection and target recognition, the demand for studying the electromagnetic (EM) scattering of moving complex target has become increasingly prominent. In this paper, the EM scattering of moving target is investigated based on the shooting and bouncing ray (SBR) algorithm combined with the rotation matrix method. And the EM scattering characteristics of moving complex target under different motion attitudes are analyzed. In the numerical results, the EM scattering of moving target is calculated by the proposed algorithm and compared with the results by the FEKO-MFLMM method, which shows good consistency. Then, the motion model of aircraft formation is established. Finally, the backscattering of moving aircraft formation is solved, and the EM scattering characteristics of moving aircraft formation are analyzed. It proves that this method can consume less time while ensuring computational accuracy for solving the EM scattering of complex moving targets.

articleTitle: A compact broadband amplifier for 5G FR2 in 65nm CMOS
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a compact broadband amplifier is realized based on 65nm CMOS technology. The three differential CMOS pairs adopt the common source (CS) structure, rely on the capacitance neutralization technology and use the transformer for impedance transformation to achieve ultra-wideband matching. The simulation results show that in FR2 frequency band (24.26 - 52.6GHz), the output gain of the amplifier is 17±2.5dB, the DC power consumption is 45mW, the supply voltage is 1V, and the core circuit area is 0.11mm2.

articleTitle: Dual-Feed Dual-Beam Conformal Holographic Metasurface Antenna Design Based on the Partitioned Aperture
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A dual-feed dual-beam conformal holographic metasurface antenna is proposed based on the partitioned aperture method. Two partitioned antenna apertures are designed, which divide the full antenna array into two parts. One part generates a high-gain, high-directivity pencil-shaped beam, and the other part generates orbital angular momentum (OAM) vortex waves. By switching the state of ON and OFF of the feeding sources, these two different radiation beams are manipulated, which realizes the multi-functionalization of the designed conformal holographic metasurface antenna. This antenna can be applied in wireless power transfer and communication.

articleTitle: An Antenna Array Design Method Based on Residual Graph Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A learning method based on residual graph neural network was proposed to improve the efficiency of antenna array design. Firstly, the geometric parameters of the antenna array are processed into graph representation, which is used as the input features of the graph neural network. After the graph encoding process, the complex-valued fully connected network with residual connections is used to predict the radiation pattern of the antenna array. Based on the residual graph neural network, a seven-element linear array structure is designed to prove its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Low Rank Approximation Approach for Microwave Radar Coincidence Imaging
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A low rank approximation algorithm for the Microwave Radar Coincidence Imaging (MRCI) is proposed in this paper. As a novel method of the radar imaging, the MRCI has the characteristics of high resolution and strong antiinference. Nevertheless, the imaging result will be aggravated when the Signal Noise Ratio (SNR) is low due to the illcondition of the reference matrix. Hence, a low rank approximation approach combined with conventional sparse reconstruction algorithm is proposed to improve the performance of the MRCI in the low SNR environment. First, the reference matrix is decomposed into the product of two matrices and the ranks of two matrices are analyzed. Then the low rank approximation approach is adopted and a new approximate imaging equation is estimated. Combined with SBL algorithm, the performance of reconstructed image is improved especially when the SNR is low. Simulation results are presented to validate the whole analysis and the proposed approach.

articleTitle: A Transformer-Based Network for Human Pose Estimation using Millimeter Wave Radar Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper proposes a human pose estimation method based on multi-angle millimeter wave radar images. The multi-angle images imply the 3D modeling of humans that can be used to recognize the pose. However, existing methods combine multi-angle features relying on local receptive fields, which misses the global information and has a poor precision of human pose reconstruction. A new network structure based on a transformer module is proposed in this paper to extract global information from multi-angle data and obtain an accurate human pose. In the proposed method, the transformer module is added between the encoder network and the decoder network. Then, a confidence refinement network is used to improve the position precision of human keypoints. Finally, a cross-modal supervision framework is utilized to train the network. Experimental results demonstrate an average OKS value of 0.716 in the AP75 evaluation metric, representing a 10% improvement over traditional networks.

articleTitle: Space-Division-Based Stroke Classification and Localization Using Microwave Medical Sensing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a novel methodology in the field of microwave medical sensing, which enables quick classification and localization of strokes without the need for imaging. The method introduced in this study utilizes space division within the region under examination, specifically the head, by leveraging the principles of the generalized scattering matrix theory and incorporating a prior knowledge of brain anatomy. Furthermore, a unique approach based on decision tree learning method is proposed to enhance the identification of stroke features for effective classification. The simulation results demonstrate noteworthy enhancements in both the accuracy of stroke classification and the efficiency of localization, surpassing the performance of the traditional method. The classification results have a 14% performance improvement, whereas the localization accuracy of the proposed method is 94%.

articleTitle: A Rapid Calculation Method for Electromagnetic Characteristics of Isomorphic Swarm Targets
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: At present, obtaining dynamic measurement data for swarm targets is both challenging and expensive. To address this issue, we propose a rapid computation method for evaluating the scattering characteristics of swarm targets. This method is based on the multilevel fast multipole algorithm (MLFMA) and utilizes the box partition data and corresponding data structure of sub-targets within the swarm target, as well as matching the induced current iteration among sub-targets. Verification results indicate that the scattering characteristics computed using the proposed algorithm are in close agreement with those derived from the MLFMA. However, our method offers significant improvements in terms of computation time and memory consumption. Consequently, this approach offers innovative technical support for generating swarm target characteristic data.

articleTitle: Finite Element Based Multiphysical Field Analysis of Tapered Slot Antennas
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The microstrip antennas are currently evolving towards smaller size and higher integration, which makes the electromagnetic-thermal effects of the antennas significant. Tapered Slot Antennas, characterized by their simple structure, low profile, high radiation efficiency, and wide operating bandwidth, have been widely used in the field of wireless communication. In this paper, starting from the steady-state conduction equation and introducing appropriate thermal boundary conditions, an analysis of the electromagnetic-thermal effects of Tapered Slot Antennas is conducted.

Author Keywords: multiphysical field analysis finite element analysis

articleTitle: A Cascade Type Bandpass Filter Based on Spoof Surface Plasmon Polariton
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a bandpass filter designed by spoofing surface plasmon polariton excitation elements. An SSPP cell was designed, and suitable data were found to achieve the dispersion characteristics of the cell structure. The results of different frequencies are achieved by the Barron structure and the SSPP structure. The structure can achieve the physical characteristics of the filter with fewer cells. Therefore, a broadband bandpass filter with controllable frequency can be obtained by design debugging. The designed BPF simulation results are good, and the filtering effect is in the frequency range of 2–8 GHz.

articleTitle: An S-Band Dual-Polarization Energy Selective Surface with Low-Cost Design
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The electromagnetic energy selective surface (ESS) can be an effective filter for high-power microwave (HPM). In this paper, an ESS with metal patches, diodes and a cross-shaped floor operating in S-band which can greatly reduce the number of applied diodes is designed. The simulated results show that the insertion loss is less than 5 dB when it is in the wave-transparent state, and the shielding efficiency is more than 17 dB when it is in the shielding state at normal incidence. Moreover, with the advantages of dual polarization, low cost and good energy selection characteristics, it will have promising applications for the HPM protection of communication and radar systems.

articleTitle: Switchable Rasorber/Absorber Based on PIN Diodes
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: To improve its stealth performance within the passband, a reconfigurable rasorber/absorber with resorbing and absorbing states is presented. By introducing PIN diodes, proposed devices achieve a switchable function. At the lossless layer, a square-slot patch is designed to match the transmission window of the resistive layer to achieve a lower insertion loss. Equivalent circuit model of switchable rabsorber/absorber is constructed to provide physical insight into operation. Finally, the simulated results of switchable rasorber/absorber show that the intermediate transmission band can be switched between ON and OFF states.

articleTitle: Design of an Electron Optical System for a 220 GHz Sheet Beam Traveling Wave Tube
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The design and simulation of an electron optical system (EOS) for a 220 GHz sheet beam traveling wave tube (SB-TWT) are presented in this paper, which includes a bidirectional compression electron gun (E-gun) and a periodic cusped magnet-quadrupolar magnet (PCM-QM) focusing structure. CST simulation results show that this E-gun can produce a sheet electron beam with an emitted current of 0.1 A at a beam voltage of 30 kV and its cross-section at the beam waist is 0.7 mm x 0.1 mm. Under the focusing of the PCM-QM, the sheet electron beam can be stably transported through an 80 mm-long beam tunnel with a cross-sectional size of 0.826 mm x 0.143 mm. A high transmission rate of up to 99.7% is obtained.

articleTitle: Effects of Key Factors on Uncertainty Quantifications in Full-wave Inverse Scattering Problems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Recently, deep learning schemes have played an increasing role in electromagnetic inverse scattering problems (ISPs). Different with traditional physics-based solvers, data-driven learning approaches are not reliable due to the lack of explainability. Thus, uncertainty quantifications of learning approaches attract a lot of attentions recently, which shows the confidence level of a prediction without knowing the true value. However, the selections of key factors in uncertainty quantification methods are indeterminate. In this paper, we quantify the uncertainty in ISPs and analyze the impact of key factors on reconstruction accuracy and uncertainty quantification performance, which include the dropout rate in both training stage and testing stage and the number of incident sources.

articleTitle: An Intelligent MT Data Inversion Method Constrained by Seismic Texture
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: We study an intelligent magnetotelluric (MT) data inversion with the constraint of seismic texture. A convolutional neural network (CNN)-based image style operator is constructed based on a pre-trained VGG19 network, serving as a measurement tool for assessing the texture of the seismic section and the resistivity model. By simultaneously reconstructing a base model and a fine model, the final reconstruction is able to reflect both the macroscopic geo-electric structure and the fine subsurface geological texture. The optimization is performed using Adaptive Moment Estimation (Adam) with the gradient calculated with the automatic differentiation (AD) method. Synthetic experiments demonstrate that the proposed method elevates inversion accuracy and yields a high-resolution resistivity model that bears the patterns of the seismic section.

articleTitle: Inverse Design of Dielectric Resonator Based on the Multipole Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Based on the physics-inspired neural network, forward prediction and inverse design approaches are proposed to optimize dielectric nano-brick. The Cartesian multipole analysis and Lorentz model are used to extract the feature parameters of the scattering spectrum of a resonance mode. The proposed forward predicting approach predicts the feature parameters of the scattering spectrum in the whole visible region. The proposed inverse design approach achieves the optimized geometries of dielectric nano-brick by inputting the feature parameters of desired scattering spectrum. The proposed approaches have the potential to accelerate the inverse design process of dielectric resonator.

articleTitle: A Narrow band High Power Microwave Measurement System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: To meet the power and field strength accurate measurement requirements of the narrow band high power microwave (HPM) effect test systems, a HPM measurement system covering S C and X band has been established, and the uncertainty of measurement results have been preliminarily analyzed. The structure of measurement system and the quantities of uncertainty have been presented in this paper.

articleTitle: A Novel Sub-6 GHz and Millimeter Wave Shared-Aperture 5G Base Station Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a novel embedded dual-band shared-aperture base station antenna, which can work in Sub-6 GHz and millimeter wave band simultaneously. The Sub-6 GHz element is composed of a driving patch and a radiating patch. The millimeter wave element uses the substrate integrated waveguide slot antenna, and the millimeter wave elements are embedded in the radiation patch of the Sub-6 GHz element, sharing the substrate and radiator of the radiation patch. Compared with the traditional embedded shared-aperture structure, this novel scheme is more compact, and the radiation environment of the higher and lower band is relatively independent, so the cross-band coupling has less effect. The simulated results show that the reflection coefficient of the proposed antenna array is less than -14 dB, the cross-band isolation is greater than 38 dB, and the cross-polarization discrimination is greater than 27 dB in the two frequency bands of 3.35-3.75 GHz and 25.8-26.2 GHz.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Model of Nonlinear Electromagnetic Inverse Problem Based on Total Variation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Electromagnetic inverse scattering problem (EISP) is difficult to solve due to its ill-posedness and nonlinearity. Iterative methods, such as subspace-based optimization method (SOM), usually associates with too many iterations to achieve satisfying results. In this work, we introduce total variation (TV) into the objective function of SOM as a regularization term to preprocess data, and then train a U-Net model to predict details in the unknowns (STU method for short). TV regularization term accelerates the convergence speed by incorporating a priori information, and the preprocessed data can also reduce the training epochs of U-Net model, making the mean relative error of the final predicted results smaller. More importantly, the proposed STU method is more suitable for fast and light weight training in deep learning based inverse scattering solvers.

articleTitle: A Dual-band Reflectarray Antenna with Low Radar Cross Section
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A dual-band reflectarray antenna with low radar cross section (RCS) is proposed in this work, which is composed of a band-stop frequency selective surface (FSS) in the upper layer and an absorptive layer at bottom. The upper FSS layer has two stop-bands at C-/X-band and can provide a 360° in-band phase shift in these two bands, so that a reflectarray antenna working at the two bands can be realized. The simulation results show that the 3-dB gain bandwidth for the proposed reflectarray antenna can achieve 17.8% with a center frequency of 5.2 GHz and 12.79% with a center frequency of 9.5GHz; while the aperture efficiencies for each band is 52.6% and 20%, with maximum gains of 27.44 dBi and 28.45 dBi, respectively. Furthermore, by adding an absorptive layer beneath the FSS layer, the RCS reduction of more than 10dB can be achieved from 1 GHz to 13 GHz for the proposed reflectarray antenna.

articleTitle: Multifunctional Frequency Selective Rasorber with Switchable Transmission/Reflection Band
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A reconfigurable rasorber has been designed based on switching activity of frequency selective surface (FSS) and resistive FSS and polarization converter layer. The proposed design consists of three periodic layers separated from each other by air pacer. The upper layer assists the reduction of the co-polarized reflection coefficient in the higher frequency band by polarization transformation. The second layer comprising resistors contributes to wide absorption band. With the help of these two layers, the absorption band from 1 to 7.2 GHz is covered the full operation frequency band. The bottom layer with PIN diodes enable switching transmission/reflection band, which switches from a bandpass response to reflection from 3.4 to 4.6 GHz.

articleTitle: Quasi-Isotropic Radiation Pattern Synthesis Using Triple Equivalent Magnetic Current Sources Based on Open-Ended Cavity Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper proposes a quasi-isotropic antenna design method based on open-ended cavity antenna using triple equivalent magnetic current sources. By cutting the slit on the side wall of the open-ended cavity antenna, the omnidirectional radiation pattern of the open-ended cavity antenna is transformed into a quasi-isotropic radiation pattern. The proposed quasi-isotropic antenna has a gain variation of 3.7 dB and an impedance bandwidth of 100 MHz (center frequency is 2.45 GHz).

articleTitle: SVD Description to Subsurface Strata Based on Borehole Radar
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Originally, borehole radar (BHR) is a subsurface geological structure detection and imaging tool. However, when borehole is filled with the very conductive medium, the radar wave will be attenuated seriously which results in BHR cannot work well. In this paper, a stratum evaluation method based on joint time-frequency analysis and singular value decomposition is developed. The method can be used to process the BHR data acquired from the conductive borehole condition. The evaluation results show a high correlation with the strata resistivity, and can be potentially used to classify the strata. Unlike the normal inversion of dielectric constant and conductivity, where massive computing resources are consumed, the proposed method is simple and rapid. Finally, the proposed method is verified by a data set acquired from a real BHR field test, and the results is compared with the conventional resistivity curves, which shows good correlation.

articleTitle: On the Calculating Method of Frequency Interference Margin Between Radars
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The frequency interference margin between radars is introduced and its calculating method is presented based on the radar signal detection process. The calculating results show that the frequency interference margins between radars depend on the radar pulse width, middle frequency, etc.

articleTitle: A Low-Profile Circularly Polarized End-Fire Antenna Based on Substrate-Integrated Waveguide Horn
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a novel circularly polarized end-fire antenna operating in the L-band, designed specifically for personal mobile communication terminals. The antenna utilizes a substrate-integrated waveguide (SIW) horn to achieve end-fire radiation. To achieve left-handed circular polarization (LHCP), slots are introduced on the metallic frame of the device. Through simulations, we demonstrate that the designed antenna can achieve LHCP end-fire radiation within the frequency range of 1560–1610 MHz, with an in-band reflection loss better than 6 dB and an axial ratio (AR) better than 3.6 dB. The circularly polarized end-fire antenna exhibits extremely low-profile characteristics and holds great potential for applications in personal mobile communication terminals.

articleTitle: Study on Composite Scattering Characteristics of a Ship Target in Island Region
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, the shooting and bouncing ray (SBR) method combined with the physical theory of diffraction (PTD) is applied to solve the composite electromagnetic (EM) scattering of a ship located in an island region. The digital elevation model (DEM) containing terrain information of the region is used as the geometrical model. The distribution of landforms in DEM is extracted from satellite images utilizing image annotation tools. The island model is derived by combining DEM terrain data with landform distribution. Limited by the DEM resolution and the loss of sea state information, the sea part of the aforementioned island model is replaced by a simulated sea surface. Finally, the recombined island model is used in investigating the scattering mechanism of a ship in island background. By comparing the results, it can be concluded that the intensity of composite scattering mainly comes from the specular reflection of the island background in the mirror direction and the coupling effect of the ship in the backscatter direction.

articleTitle: Investigation of Frequency Characteristics of Vortex Electromagnetic Beams
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Electromagnetic waves carrying orbital angular momentum (OAM) can achieve high azimuth-resolution imaging without relative motion between radar and target. Due to the hollow beam nature of vortex waves, the beam distribution would affect the quality of imaging. In this paper, based on the vortex electromagnetic waves produced by a uniform circular array (UCA), the effects of carrier frequencies on the direction and width of vortex electromagnetic beams with different OAM modes are studied, and the performance of imaging of multiple targets in different elevation angles under the irradiation of vortex electromagnetic waves with different frequencies is investigated. The results verify that carrier frequency variation causes obvious beam divergence, and selecting appropriate carrier frequencies can optimize the imaging performance of targets within different elevation regions.

articleTitle: Design of 1-Bit Wideband Radiation-Type Reconfigurable Antenna Element
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper proposes a wideband radiation-type reconfigurable antenna element with 1-bit phase resolution. Two PIN diodes are integrated into each element to realize current path reversal and the required 1-bit phase quantization. The operating band of the proposed element is 6.9 GHz - 8.8 GHz with relative bandwidth of 24.2% at 7.85 GHz. The maximum realized gain of the proposed element reaches 4.75dBi and the cross-polarization is less than -30 dB at the two states, which means the proposed element has good characteristics of radiation beam reconfiguration.

articleTitle: Design of Filtering Power Divider Based on LTCC Process
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In order to miniaturize passive devices in communication systems, a filter power divider module is designed using a low-temperature co-fired ceramic (LTCC) process. This combines a bandpass filter and a power divider, effectively reducing the size and achieving miniaturization of the device. ADS software is used to simulate the equivalent circuit diagram, and HFSS software is used to optimize the design and simulation of the 3D model. The dimensions of the filter power divider designed in this paper are 4mm×2mm×2.45mm, and the operating band is 5~6GHz. The simulation results are: insertion loss is less than 4.4dB, return loss is more than 10dB, and isolation is more than 17dB, which can be used in wifi6.

articleTitle: Simulation of Multiscale Microwave Circuit via a Mixed Order Finite Element Time Domain Method Combined with Domain Decomposition Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a mixed order finite element time domain (FETD) method combined with domain decomposition (DD) algorithm is introduced. The hierarchical function is utilized since it allows the use of different orders within the same computational domain. Under the uniform mesh generation, the high order basis functions H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> are used in fine structures and the low order basis functions H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> are used in conventional structure. By means of the mixed order vector function, the accuracy and ability of FETD simulation of multiscale EM problems are improved. Meanwhile, combined with nonoverlapping tearing and interconnecting algorithm, the ill-conditioned large sparse linear systems obtained by the higher order hierarchical vector can be solved with direct solvers. Therefore, the memory requirement and the computation complexity have been reduced. The electromagnetic characteristics of multiscale microwave passive device is simulated and analyzed by the proposed method.

articleTitle: The Research of Electromagnetic Simulation Trusted Evaluation Technology Based on Super-Computing Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The electromagnetic compatibility problem of communication systems is becoming increasingly prominent, and more and more electromagnetic simulation capabilities are introduced into product design. However, the credibility of the simulation is an important issue. Aiming at the electromagnetic compatibility design problem of chassis and cabinet, this paper uses the powerful computing power system of super-computing platform to study the credibility evaluation method based on feature selective verification method (FSV), and establishes a trusted computing evaluation method for electromagnetic simulation based on super-computing platform.

articleTitle: Parallel Electromagnetic Modeling for Connectors Based on Domain Decomposition Preconditioners
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, we demonstrate the simulation of a high-speed connector by the non-overlapping domain decomposition method (DDM). Subdomain systems are decoupled through the second-order Robin transmission condition (SOTC). Then LU-decomposed sub-systems are applied to the FEM linear system as a preconditioner. Computed S-parameters and crosstalks agree with the results from commercial software. The DDM preconditioned solver greatly reduces the solution time compared to the direct solver, while remaining robust when the number of processes rises.

articleTitle: A Tunable Bandpass Frequency-Selective Surface with High Selectivity
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A tunable bandpass frequency-selective surface (FSS) with high selectivity is presented in this article. The FSS structure is composed of four stacked metallic layers and loaded with eight varactors. The metal structures in each layer are connected by metal vias to provide bias for the varactors. This configuration realizes the fusion of bias network and FSS structure. Simulation results show that by changing the varactor capacitance from 0.1 to 0.6 pF, the center frequency of the passband is moved from 6.27 to 12.27 GHz. In the frequency tuning range, the rectangle coefficient (RC) value of the FSS structure is less than 0.27.

articleTitle: A General Integral Equation Modeling Method for Analyzing Complex Wire Antennas with Junctions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The general method of moments (MoM) for crossed thin wire structures is an easily overlooked key technology, and few scholars have classified and discussed the treatment of the boundary condition on crossed thin wire structures in detail. In this paper, a robust method of moments (MoM) approach is proposed for complex thin wire antennas. Based on the structural characteristics of thin wire antennas, several important steps are presented in this article: basis function selection, integration kernel processing, degree-of-freedom reduction, and basis function elimination. These steps form a systematic solution, and the correctness and the efficiency of the algorithm is demonstrated through numerical examples.

articleTitle: Dual Polarized Dual Beam Converging Vortex Antenna Based on Reflective Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the traditional reflector array antenna only produces a single polarized wave, a double-polarized double-beam converging reflector array antenna is proposed in this paper. A “wrench type” metasurface element structure is designed. The unit is selected to form a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$17\times 17$</tex> array, and the array size is 255 mm <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\times 255\text{mm}(8.5\lambda_{0}\times 8.5\lambda_{0})$</tex>. The simulation results show that: Under 10 GHz, the vortex antenna designed in this paper successfully generates dual-beam convergent vortex waves with different modes and different beams pointing at different polarization directions. When the x-polarized wave is incident, the OAM mode <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$l_{\mathrm{x}}=+1$</tex>, the beam direction <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\theta= +30^{\circ}\varphi=+180^{\circ}$</tex>. When the y-polarized wave is incident, OAM mode <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$l_{\mathrm{y}}=+2$</tex>, beam direction <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\theta=+30^{\circ}, \varphi=0^{\circ}$</tex>.

articleTitle: Design of a Miniaturised Wide-Stopband SIW Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a miniaturized wide-stopband SIW dual-band filter. SIW limits the propagation of electromagnetic waves and thus enables the miniaturization of the filter. A passband below the waveguide cutoff frequency is generated by etching the CSRR structure on the surface of the SIW, while a modified CSRR-DGS structure is etched on the backside of the SIW structure, and the other passband is generated by coupling the CSRR etched on the surface of the SIW to the ground. In addition, the CSRR-DGS structure broadens the stopband without increasing the filter size. Through the circuit equivalent analysis and parameter optimization of the filter structure, the final simulation results are as follows: the filter has a passband of 3.5 GHz (WIMAX) and 5.2 GHz (WLAN), the 3dB bandwidths of the two bands are 130MHz and 180MHz respectively, the insertion loss is 0.5 dB and 0.65 dB, and the size is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.18\lambda_{\mathrm{g}}\times 0.27\lambda_{\mathrm{g}}$</tex>. Overall, it achieves high performance and also has a wide range of applications.

articleTitle: An Investigation of LF Groundwave Propagation Characteristics Over Sea Covered by Ice Using the Parabolic Equation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The parabolic equation (PE) method is applied to investigate the amplitude and phase characteristics of low-frequency (LF) groundwave propagation over sea covered by ice. The “ice-sea” stratified medium is characterized by the effective surface impedance of a two-layer half-space model in the PE. Calculations performed for four ice thicknesses (0, 1, 2, 3 m) show that the ice surface of sea significantly affects the propagation of LF groundwave, especially for phase. Also, as the ice thickness increases from 0 to 3 m, the secondary time delay of LF groundwave increases up to 189 ns at a range of 200 km due to the more inductive effective surface impedance for the thicker ice. This indicates that to achieve higher maritime position, navigation, and timing (PNT) accuracy of LF radio navigation systems, the time delay caused by the ice surface of sea should be properly mitigated.

articleTitle: Interference Type Recognition Algorithm of Coherent Forwarding Jamming based on Wavelet Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: With the large-scale application of Digital Radio Frequency Memory (DRFM) in electronic countermeasures equipment, coherent forwarding jamming has gradually become the mainstream of jammer selection. This type of interference is perfectly suited to DRFM hardware, and can also make the interference waveform obtain the system gain of the radar side, achieving good interference effect. To realize the classification and identification of such interference, the Wavelet Neural Network (WNN) in the field of computer is introduced into the field of electronic countermeasures for the first time in this paper, and the network is improved to identify the type of coherent relaying jamming for Pulse Doppler (PD) radar. According to the simulation results, compared with the existing Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural network, the proposed method can improve the recognition accuracy by about 30% under the same parameter scale.

articleTitle: A Direct Synthesis Approach for Dual-Band Filters Based on Frequency-Variant Triplets
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a direct matrix method is presented to synthesize a quasi-canonical dual passband filter based on frequency-variant triplets, which is based on two low-pass prototypes and can achieve different passbands with different bandwidths, orders, and return losses. Compared with the conventional triplet, the proposed method can achieve more transmission zeros with quasi-canonical characteristics without increasing the cross-coupling paths, i.e., the frequency-variant triplet can generate two transmission zeros. Starting from the wheel topology, the process of using matrix transformation to realize the frequency-variant triplet topology is given in detail. A fifth-order, four-zero-point, dual-pass band filter synthesis procedure is given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the synthesis method.

articleTitle: Scattering Center Parametric Modeling of Target above on the Rough Surface
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, under conical wave incidence, the backscattering field from a rough surface is firstly calculated by the physical optics (PO) method. Meanwhile, based on magnitude of surface current calculated by po, the strong scattering point and its scattering intensity can be established, based on the backscattering field, the high-resolution range profile (HRRP) is simulated through the inverse fast Fourier transform (IFFT). through the characteristics of the HRRP and the geometry of the rough surface, length parameters and frequency dependent para -meters are established. Then the scattering center parametric modeling is constructed. Based on this modeling, HRRP is reconstructed. The new HRRP is compared with initial to verify the effectiveness of scattering center parameterized modeling.

articleTitle: Design of A Differentially-fed Filtering Patch Antenna with High Roll-off Rate
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This letter presents a filtering patch antenna with high roll-off rate. The antenna consists of two F4b substrates, four shorting pins, four microstrip split rings, a radiating patch, and a metal ground. By loading four microstrip split rings, a radiation null is generated outside the upper band. The second radiation null is obtained by etching four pairs of slots around the feeding structure. Thus, a bandpass filtering response is obtained for the radiation gain. Simulation results show that the proposed filtering antenna operates at 2.81-2.85 GHz with two radiation nulls at 2.76 GHz and 2.89 GHz, separately. the calculated roll-off rate for the realized gain is 480.6 dB/GHz and 823.2 dB/GHz at the band edge. Unidirectional radiation patterns and stable radiation gains are also observed at the operation band.

articleTitle: A Prediction Method for Radiation Emission of Interconnecting Bent Cables with Connectors
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) design verification of complex systems such as power electronic systems, it is urgent to put forward efficient electromagnetic interference (EMI) modeling and analysis methods to carry out the radiation prediction and evaluation of high-power electromechanical interconnected transmission lines (TLs) networks. This paper proposes a novel EMI modeling approach for bent TLs with connectors in any position, which consists of MTL, chain parameter matrix, and multi-port theory. This method has two obvious advantages: one is the equivalent circuit of the connector can be established without knowing the exact information of the internal structure, and the other is that it does not need to mesh the TLs, which can reduce a lot of computing resources. Experimental was carried out first to verify this proposed method's accuracy and validity. Then, bent TLs with connectors on both ends and in the middle are simulated numerically and compared with the model only considering TLs. The results show that the method can be well applied to the EMI analysis of the TLs with connectors.

articleTitle: A Wideband Time-Domain Microwave System for Breast Cancer Screening
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Due to its unsafety and high price, computed to-mography (CT) technology is difficult to be widely used in breast cancer screening. This paper proposes a time-domain microwave system based on ultra-broadband pulses for breast cancer screening. The system is mainly composed of several antennas, a pulse generator, an oscilloscope, a turntable, and a computer. Acrylic cylinders with different specifications are used to simulate breast tissue. Data collection is automatically completed under the control of the computer. Finally, the dummy tissues are imaged based on the delay-multiply-and-sum (DMAS) algorithm. The experimental results show that tumors can be roughly localized by the proposed system, which means that the time-domain microwave system can serve as a promising candidate for breast cancer screening.

articleTitle: Modified Frith transfer formula method based on SBR method Using to quickly solve the coupling degree of antennas in multi-platform formation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In the problem of antenna coupling degree solving, the structure of aerial platform is becoming more complicated, and the distance of aerial platform is becoming more tight, so the traditional Frith transmission formula is no longer applicable. A hybrid algorithm is proposed to quickly solve the coupling degree of antennas between different platforms in multi-platform formation. SBR method is used to solve the electromagnetic wave reflection of the complex structure of the air platform, and several coupling paths from the interfered antenna to the disturbed antenna were obtained. The method greatly reduces the requirement of simulation resources and time consumption, and is more efficient than the traditional method.

articleTitle: Multi-Physics Simulation and Optimization of the MPCVD Device
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Microwave plasma chemical vapor deposition (MPCVD) technology is a crucial technique for fabricating high-quality diamond films. However, the present equipment's limitations in terms of low growth rate and subpar quality impose severe constraints on the mass production of diamond products. Addressing the developmental requirements of MPCVD devices, a comprehensive study encompassing a multi-physics simulation method and optimization design of MPCVD devices was undertaken.

articleTitle: The Applicability of the Theory of Equivalent Medium for Moist Aerosol in Terahertz Band
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In order to evaluate the potential applications of terahertz waves in space communication, radar, remote sensing, etc., it is necessary to study the transmission characteristics of terahertz waves in the atmosphere. In this paper, a scattering model of terahertz waves by wet particles is given based on the equivalent medium theory(EMT), and the applicability range of the equivalent medium theory is analyzed using the generalized Mie theory(GLMT). The influence of refractive index of particles on terahertz Gaussian beam is discussed at a specific window frequency. The numerical simulation results show that the EMT is suitable for the analysis when the humidity is greater than 0.0001. The real part of the refractive index is more sensitive to absorption of electromagnetic waves, and the waist radius of the beam has little effect on the scattering characteristics of electromagnetic wave.

articleTitle: Study on the Conical Logarithmic Spiral Antenna Array
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Some configurations of conical logarithmic spiral antenna (CLSA) arrays are simulated and discussed. CLSA array is a high gain broadband wide beam circularly polarized antenna array, which can be used in radar and communication systems, however, we find performance degradation when we arraying CLSA. We study the array's performance base on the distance between active regions of elements, which is the critical fact when we constructing an array. Finally, an array strategy which can effectively avoid performance degradation is given.

articleTitle: A Backscattering-Enhanced Metasurface with Dual-Polarization Under Large-Angle Oblique Incidence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The flexible control of electromagnetic waves by metasurfaces has gained significant attention. However, there is limited research on planar metasurfaces for backscattering enhancement in the microwave frequency band. One challenge arises when the incident wave angle becomes too large, as it becomes difficult to accurately reflect the waves at the desired angle. In this paper, a planar phase gradient metasurface is designed. The reflective unit cell can cover a huge phase variation of at least 332° when the incident angle of electromagnetic waves is 60° and the frequency is 10GHz. Simulation tests were conducted using the metasurface with thirteen different unit cells arrangements. The results demonstrate that both TM polarized and TE polarized waves can be effectively reflected backwards at an oblique incidence angle of 60°. The strongest backscattering angle are found to be 59° and 58° respectively, achieving backscattering enhancement in consistent with the expected angle.

articleTitle: An Enhanced U-Net Scheme with Self-Attention Mechanism for Inverse Scattering Problems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The nonlinearity and ill-posedness of the inverse scattering problems make them difficult to solve. Multiple scattering effects are the main cause of nonlinearity. In this paper, a deep learning method with self-attention mechanism is proposed to address the difficulties caused by multiple scattering effects. The main block of the proposed network architecture combines self-attention layers and convolutional layers, enhancing the global perception ability of the network. Numerical results show that the proposed method achieves higher accuracy in solving the inverse scattering problem compared to architectures relying solely on convolutional neural networks.

articleTitle: Miniaturized Terahertz Source Based on Micro-nano-grating Dielectric Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous progress of science and technology, terahertz technology has been widely applied. In the preparation of terahertz sources, vacuum electronics technology has always been one of the main research directions. However, the traditional vacuum electronic light source has some shortcomings, such as high energy consumption, easy to damage the crystal and easy to be subjected to environmental noise. Therefore, how to achieve miniaturized, high-efficiency and low-cost terahertz light sources has always been the focus of researchers' attention. In this respect, the miniaturized terahertz source based on micro-nano-grating dielectric waveguide provides us with a new solution. We construct a terahertz source based on a micro-nano-grating dielectric waveguide with an operating frequency of 32THz, which can be driven by single electrons, electron bunches and periodic electron sequences. In addition, the miniaturized terahertz source has the advantages of easy integration and low preparation cost. It can be used in terahertz optics, communication, development, biomedical engineering and other fields.

articleTitle: Effective Neumann Boundary Condition for Boundary Layer at Ohmic Contact
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The ohmic contacts in semiconductor simulation lead to thin boundary layers with sharp peaks in simulations. It stems from singular logarithmic quasi-Fermi potential function. This paper proposes an effective Neumann condition. Such a boundary condition reduces computational cost and retains rather high accuracy simultaneously. This method is tested with a PN junction and validated by the accuracy of terminal current.

articleTitle: Study on Electromagnetic Interference Effect of Reconnaissance Equipment Under Complex Electromagnetic Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: With the development of the electronics and information technology, the electromagnetic environment of the battlefield space is filled with more and more radiation source signals and intentional interference signals. It is of great significance to study the electromagnetic interference (EMI) effect of reconnaissance equipment in the complex electromagnetic environment to grasp the electromagnetic situation of the electromagnetic space. In this paper, influence of exterior environment on frequency-domain and direction measurement performance of typical reconnaissance equipment is modelled and simulated. Then the EMI effect is analyzed and the frequency and direction measurement parameters of reconnaissance equipment is studied. The results show that the parameter measurement error is less than 1.2% when there is no large interference, and when there is inner noise and external interference concurrently, the bandwidth and pitch angle will have a large deviation.

Author Keywords: spectrum estimation method for frequency measurement

articleTitle: Design of High-performance 110GHz Quasi- Optical Mode Converter for Gyrotron Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents the design and analysis of a prototype quasi-optical mode converter with high conversion efficiency for 110GHz <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{TE}22,6$</tex> applications. The mode converter incorporates the Denisov launcher, which is based on the periodic perturbation concept, resulting in a primary radiation field with low edge diffraction. An iterative phase correction technique, based on the co-polarization field component, is employed to achieve high-quality mode conversion. Numerical investigations confirm that the phase-shaped mirror system significantly improves conversion performance. The design has achieved remarkably high Gaussian content reaching 99.89% for co- polarization, as well as relatively high power transmission efficiency reaching 99.13%.

articleTitle: Study on Composite Electromagnetic Scattering on One-Dimensional Soil Surface and Moving Target Above it
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In order to meet the needs of radar target detection, recognition and classification above the soil surface, the spatial domain synthesis method is chosen to generate the soil surface with altitude fluctuation that obeys the Alpha-stable distribution. The Topp model is chosen to simulate the dielectric constant of the soil, and the method of moments is applied to study the composite electromagnetic scattering of the soil and the triangular cross-section column moving target above it under the conical wave incident condition, and the variation curve of composite scattering coefficient with scattering angle is obtained. The effects of lateral translation, longitudinal translation, rotation and incident angle of electromagnetic wave on composite scattering coefficient are discussed.

articleTitle: Array Antenna Based on Low RCS Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper proposes an array antenna based on low radar cross-section metasurface. Using the cross-arrangement distribution of metasurfaces and appropriate feeding techniques to excite some metasurface units to generate effective radiation. These partially excited metasurfaces serve a dual purpose as the radiating structure of the array antenna and as part of the scattering structure with low RCS properties. The results show that the array antenna achieves good radiation performance with a working bandwidth of 13.99-19.08 GHz. There is a significant RCS reduction within the bandwidth of 12-27.76GHz, which can be used in stealth platforms.

articleTitle: Prediction of Global Ionospheric TEC based on Deep Learning and Singular Spectrum Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: To predict global ionospheric total electron content (TEC), this paper applies Singular Spectrum Analysis (SSA) for the extraction of trend, periodic, and irregular components form Spherical Harmonic (SH) coefficients. It further employs Convolutional Long Short-Term Memory (ConvLSTM)-based machine learning models to construct an encoder-decoder neural network for short-term prediction of TEC. The training set, ranging from March 2017 to October 2018, includes the trend, periodic, and irregular components form the SH coefficients, ap indices, DST indices, days of the year, and hours of the day. For testing set 1, which spans from November 2016 to February 2017, the root mean squared error (RMSE) is 0.72 TECU and 1.20 TECU for the first- and second-hour predictions, respectively <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${(1 T E C U}=10^{16} \text{el} / \mathrm{m}^2)$</tex>. For testing set 2, covering the period from November 2018 to February 2019, the RMSE of the prediction results is 0.55 TECU and 0.90 TECU.

articleTitle: A Compact Broadband Dielectric Resonator Magnetoelectric Dipole Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a new broadband dielectric resonator magnetoelectric (DR-ME) dipole antenna is proposed. The DR-ME dipole antenna consists of a metal semi-loop, two L-shaped feed lines, and a rectangular dielectric resonator (DR) with a slot. One of the L-shaped lines is excited and the other one is grounded. The feed lines are coupled with the semi-loop to control its electric current distribution. The feeding structure can excite the DR's <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{TE}_{\boldsymbol{\delta} \mathbf{11}}$</tex> mode. The semi-loop and its image can work as a magnetic dipole while the DR can be equivalent to an electric dipole. Thus, a DR-ME dipole antenna is designed. The electric size of the antenna is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{0.29}\boldsymbol{\lambda}_{\mathbf{0}}\times \mathbf{0.29}\boldsymbol{\lambda}_{0}\times \mathbf{0.26}\boldsymbol{\lambda}_{0} ((\boldsymbol{\lambda}_{0}$</tex> is the free-space wavelength at the center frequency). According to the full-wave simulation, the -10 dB bandwidth of the antenna is 18.7%, spanning from 1.98 GHz to 2.39 GHz. The front-to-back ratio is better than 18 dB within the operating band.

articleTitle: Two-Channel CNN for Cone-Shaped Space Target Identification Enhanced by Scattering Center Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Due to the correlation between electromagnetic scattering features and target structures, this paper proposes a two-channel convolutional neural network for cone-shaped space target identification. The performance of prediction accuracy is enhanced by the scattering center model. This method mainly consists of three parts, scattering center model extraction, construction of scattering features dataset, and parameter identification based on two-channel convolutional neural network. The method integrates different scattering features of the target and improves the accuracy of target identification.

articleTitle: A Method of Limit Decomposition on Electric Field Radiation Emission for Electronic System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a decomposition method for limit of radiation emission inside an electronic system is proposed to solve the problems based on 10kHz-18GHz electric field. As the model structure, hierarchical structure and overall radiation limit of the entire system to be designed are determined, such radiation emission limit could be decomposed to obtain the limits of each electrical module, PCB board, and component inside this system in order. Thus, the overall radiation emission limit of the entire system could be allocated to each micro portion appropriately, in order that all segments subdivided for analysis could meet their radiation emission limits and to reach better electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) performance inside the entire system.

articleTitle: Broadband RCS Reduction of Dihedral Corner Exploiting Bistatic RCS Reduction Surface
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Broadband RCS reduction of dihedral corner is designed exploiting broadband RCS reduction surface with better bistatic RCS reduction. The designed PCMs can maintain high polarization conversion rate in wide frequency band. The PCM and its mirror PCM are employed to design broadband monostatic RCS reduction surface and the bistatic RCS reduction is improved by arranging these PCMs in different locations. Based on the designed bistatic RCS reduction surface, broadband RCS reduction of dihedral corner is further proposed. The designed RCS reduction surface can realize 10dB bistatic RCS reduction ranging from 12 to 24GHz (67% relative bandwidth). Based on the designed RCS reduction surface, the designed dihedral can basically realize 10dB bistatic RCS reduction ranging from 12 to 26.5 GHz (72% relative bandwidth). The designed bistatic RCS reduction surface is more applicable for RCS reduction design of complex targets.

articleTitle: The Forward Method of Obtaining Stable Scattering Center
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, the forward method of obtaining the target's stable scattering center is studied. Using the ray diversity technique and forward estimation method of scattering center property parameters, we first construction the scattering center model in different attitude. Then, the exact corresponding relationship between the scattering centers under different attitudes is established according to the scattering source, further the target global scattering center model with the scattering center as the organizing unit is constructed. Finally, the target's stable scattering center is obtained statistically. The method in this paper avoids such difficulties and errors in extracting and associating the scattering center by the traditional reverse method, therefor the acquisition process of the target's stable scattering center is more direct, and the result is more accurate.

articleTitle: A Design of Wideband, Miniaturized Metasurface Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A wideband, miniaturized metasurface antenna is proposed in this letter. The antenna is composed of two layers of metasurface and a ground plane, and fed by a microstrip line through a slot cut onto the ground plane, while the metasurfaces are both formed using an array of non-uniform rectangular patches. With the feeding slot right underneath the center of the metasurfaces, three resonance modes with boresight radiation patterns are excited simultaneously. Thus, working bandwidth is expanded, miniaturization and low-profile are achieved with extra parasitic structure. The simulated results show that the −10 dB impedance bandwidth of this antenna is 6.24-8.85 GHz (34.6%), the overall efficiency in the working band is higher than 86%, with an overall size of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.44\lambda_{\mathrm{L}}\times 0.44\lambda_{\mathrm{L}}\times 0.045\lambda_{\mathrm{L}}$</tex> (where <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\lambda_{\mathrm{L}}$</tex> is free space wavelength at the lower working frequency).

articleTitle: Research on Spectrum Characteristics of Ground Penetrating Radar for Road Underground Water-rich Body
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Studying the GPR spectrum response of the road underground water-rich body will help to detect the road underground water-rich body disease and provide a decision-making basis for road safety management and hidden danger management. This paper adopts the method of model simulation and radar measured data to comprehensively analyze different types of water-rich bodies and explore the law of spectrum response of water-rich bodies. The research results show that the radar reflection wave of water-rich bodies has the characteristics of low frequency and strong reflection, decays rapidly, and has reflected wave. The conclusion shows that it is feasible and effective for ground penetrating radar to detect road underground water-rich diseases.

articleTitle: An Ultra-Fast Reconfigurable Higher-Order Topological Insulator
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Topological photonics provides a new way to design and implement electromagnetic devices with unprecedented functions. According to reports, some low-order tunable topological devices have been developed, but the control of energy of those remains at the one-dimensional level. Here, we propose a printed-circuit board (PCB) based solution for building reconfigurable higher-order topological insulator (RHOTI) using PIN diodes, which enables fast fabrication and autonomous switching of topological functions, and enables higher dimensional regulation of energy. The designed RHOTI can quickly switch between low-order low-loss waveguides at 10.24GHz and higher-order corner states at 9.75GHz. This concept is also instructive for the design of reconfigurable metamaterials and photonic crystals.

articleTitle: Innovated Education for an Innovative Generation -On Teaching “RF and Microwave Circuits” (Invited)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: How to excite students' interest in learning a hard and abstract subject on applied electromagnetics is the focus of modern era faculties. This work presents a deeply innovated classic teaching/learning approach, the so called Project Based Learning, i.e. PBL approach. Details of how we conduct the classroom teaching as well as the arrangement of technical contents are explained. Years of classroom tested experience demonstrate that this way of teaching is effective in building students' own understanding of the subject and generate a sense of academic interest.

articleTitle: EMI Radiation Prediction of Packages Based on Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: With the increase of the current operating frequency, the electromagnetic interference (EMI) problem of extra-highspeed electronic equipment and systems becomes more and more complex, and the traditional analysis and design methods cannot efficiently deal with the current EMI problems. Therefore, this paper proposes a method of predicting electromagnetic radiation using a two-dimensional (2-D) convolutional neural network (CNN) in deep learning. This method can quickly and accurately predict the maximum 3-m pin map (PINMAP) package radiation electric field. By comparing the prediction results with the full-wave simulation results, both results are in good agreement, and the CNN prediction time is at the millisecond level. Therefore, the method that can accurately and effectively predict the radiation value has been verified.

articleTitle: A Stabilized and Well-Conditioned Marching-on-in Degree Method for Transient Analysis of Dielectric Objects
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a solver for addressing the challenges of low frequency instability and high-order oscillation in dielectric scattering problems.
