The proposed solver effectively mitigates dense-mesh issues and eliminates the impact of smaller <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$s$</tex> values, which is realized by canceling the scalar component of the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathcal{L}$</tex> operator. Additionally, we employ the radial integration to ensure the stability of higher-order temporal functions. Numerical examples validate the accuracy and effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: A Multi-Band High Gain Liquid Antenna Base on Spoof Surface Plasmons
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presented a high-gain multi-band ionic liquid antenna based on a spoof surface plasmons (SPs) structure. The antenna is mainly composed of ionic liquids, an acrylic cylinder container and spoof SPs structures. The antenna is excited by a microstrip feed-line, by introducing the plasmonic structures in the ground, the multiple frequency bands have been generated. Meanwhile, two liquid dielectric resonators with spoof SPPs structures are placed on the both sides of the central cylindrical dielectric resonator (DR), the radiation beam of the antenna is further concentrated due to the strong surface waves confinement capability of spoof SPPs, and radiation performance of the antenna is further improved. The total size of the antenna is 90mm*90mm. The simulation results demonstrates that the antenna operating in five frequency bands, namely 3GHz- 3.15GHz, 3.2GHz-3.14GHz, 4.7GHz-4.9GHz, 6.1GHz-6.2GHz, and 7GHz-7.1GHz, with a maximum gain of 6.5 dBi. The proposed antenna can find many applications in the fields of wireless communication, transparent electronic devices, and Internet of Things (IoT).

articleTitle: The Analytical Solution for the Bistatic Quantum Radar Scattering of the 2D Elliptical Plate
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The quantum radar technology is very much in its infancy. There still exist fundamental issues about the calculation of its radar signatures, especially in the 2D elliptical plate. In this study, we have developed an analytical solution for the bistatic quantum radar scattering of the 2D elliptical plate. Besides, the influence of incident frequency and the angles on the bistatic quantum cross section (BIQRCS) for the object were obtained. Finally, we also revealed that the envelope curves of sidelobes in BIQRCS at the given incidence almost display the invariance in frequency.

articleTitle: Influence of Diverter Stirp on Conduction Performance of Metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, based on cross grid and jerusalem metamaterial structures, the influence of diverter stirp on its conduction performance during transient lightning response by loading soild metal diverter strip and segmented diverter strip on the surface is studied. The results show that, for the cross grid metamaterial structure, the current can not be obviously changed by loading the diverter stirp. For the jerusalem metamaterial, loading soild metal diverter strip can effectively conduct current on the surface of the structure whlie loading segmented diverter strip cannot conduct current. The results have some guiding significance in the field of lightning protection design of metamaterial.

articleTitle: Dispersion Derivation of Space-Time Modulated Spoof Surface Plasmon Polaritons
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Based on the space-time modulation theory, we analyze the dispersion relation of spoof surface plasmon polariton (SSPP). We prove that asymmetric band gap occurs in general periodic space-time modulated media. In this inclined band gap, the forward and backward harmonics exhibit different phases and group velocities, so the reciprocity can be broken. Finally, we can achieve a higher isolation level through the corresponding design of SSPP.

articleTitle: A Study on GPR Technique for Fine Characterization of Shallow Strata Structure in Lake Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The investigation of Baiyangdian lake bottom strata has very important practical significance for the Baiyangdian ecological geological survey, lake bottom ecological dredging and wetland ecological protection. In order to systematically explore the stratigraphic structure of the Baiyangdian Lake bottom, provide accurate target area data support for the drilling survey, and achieve a complete description of the lake bottom strata from the regional scale, this paper innovates the use range of ground-penetrating radar (GPR), and uses the ship-borne method to carry out the lake bottom strata exploration through the water body. Through analyzing the technical difficulties of GPR exploration for the bottom structure of Baiyangdian Lake, the characteristics of electromagnetic wave propagation in underwater exploration and the geophysical response conditions of the original formation at the bottom of the lake are analyzed in both cases with sediment, and a simplified structure model of lake bottom is established, which is composed of lake water+silt layer+original formation at the bottom of the lake. This research has realized the technical integration of modeling and analysis of lake bottom stratum structure, optimization of antenna exploration mode, and optimization of data processing process. This technical achievement provides the basic basis for the three-dimensional geological modeling of groundwater and surface water in Baiyangdian District, provides the target area support for the drilling and exploration of the lake bottom strata, and effectively promotes the construction of the water-land integrated exploration technology and method system in Baiyangdian Wetland.

Author Keywords: ground penetrating radar technology in water exploration
sand layer under the lake bottom

articleTitle: A Reconfigurable Frequency Selective Surface with High Selectivity/Angular Stability
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper proposes a reconfigurable frequency selective surface(RFSS) based on PIN diode, it has high cutoff outside the passband and certain angular stability for use in the X-band. Through the non-resonant structure cascade, a transmission zero is added to the left and right sides of the unit. After simulation, the on state can achieve 80% transmittance in the range of more than 2GHz, and the off state can achieve <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{S}_{21}< - 20\text{dB}$</tex> in the frequency range of 1-18 GHz.

articleTitle: Limiter Temperature Characteristics Prediction Based on VMD Decomposition and Autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Limiter is a key component for EMP protection. Accurately predicting the temperature characteristic curve of the limiter has crucial guiding significance for selecting protective components. Machine learning-based methods can effectively predict the characteristic curves of devices. However, the temperature characteristic curve of the limiter contains non-linearity and fluctuations, which traditional machine learning methods fail to predict accurately. Therefore, this paper proposes a prediction method integrating Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) and autoencoders. It decomposes the temperature characteristics into four components and predicts each component individually, thereby accurately predicting the temperature rise characteristic curve of the limiter.

articleTitle: A Spatial Modes Filtering FETD Method with Periodic Boundary Condition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The periodic boundary condition (PBC) is applied into the spatial modes filtering FETD (SMF-FETD) method in this paper. The coupling relationship of the electric fields at the periodic boundary is analyzed when the Floquet principle is introduced. The contribution of external electric fields to the periodic boundary fields is replaced by that of the internal electric fields. Therefore, the mass and stiffness matrices are updated. The analysis of periodic structures arrays can be transformed into the analysis of the structural unit, this greatly saves computational resources and improves the efficiency of electromagnetic modeling. Numerical example is presented to verify the effectiveness of the SMF-FETD method with PBC.

articleTitle: Analysis of Cylindrical Conformal Phased Array Based on Phase Mode Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, considering the difficulty of full-wave simulation caused by the large computational requirements, complex structure and non-uniform excitation of cylindrical conformal array antenna, a method based on the phase mode theory is applied to solve the problem, in which, the non-uniform cylindrical conformal array can be decomposed into multiple uniform cylindrical conformal arrays, then periodic structure simulation can be applied to reduce the complexity of the problem. Finally, the simulation results of different modes are superimposed to realize the fast and accurate simulation of non-uniform cylindrical conformal array. At last, the algorithm is verified by simulation and synthesis of a microstrip conformal array.

articleTitle: An Efficient Method to Extract the Effective Permittivity of the Honeycomb Composite
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The effective medium theory is proposed for analyzing the periodic honeycomb structure. The equivalent model and the effective permittivity are developed from reflection coefficient of the periodic unit. The accuracy of this method is then verified by comparing the reflection coefficients between the periodic honeycomb structure and the equivalent models, revealing a stronger agreement at different incidence angles than NRW method.

articleTitle: Efficiency Improvement of Handset Antennas by Suppressing Higher-Order Modes
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this work, a method is proposed to improve the radiation efficiency of practical mobile handset antennas by suppressing the higher-order modes within the operating band. The method is based on N-port characteristic mode theory and genetic algorithm. With the optimization, the modal coefficients of the higher-order modes within the operating band are minimized or moved out of the band to mitigate their impact. With the proposed method, antenna efficiency has been improved by 1.27 dB, without changing its main resonances.

articleTitle: A BiGRU-based Interference Mitigation Method for Automotive Millimeter-Wave Radar
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The millimeter-wave radar has become an important sensor for environmental awareness in the field of autonomous driving. With the increasing number of radar-equipped vehicles in dense traffic environments, the problem of mutual interference is inevitable. In this paper, we propose an automotive millimeter-wave radar interference mitigation method based on bidirectional gate recurrent unit (BiGRU) with residual connection. The proposed method could eliminate the interference in the time domain and improve the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of the signal. Compared with wavelet de noising and normal RNNs, our method shows better performance, which demonstrate the potential of the residual-BiGRU-based model in interference mitigation.

articleTitle: Supercomputer Based Parallel DGTD Algorithm with LTS Scheme for Electrical Large Problems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a nodal discontinuous Galerkin time-domain (NDGTD) algorithm with parallel scheme is proposed to solve transient Maxwell's equations. With the aim to analyze the electromagnetic (EM) features of electrical large problems, the NDGTD is developed on the supercomputer named “Tian-He”, where the message passing interface (MPI) is resorted to facilitate the communication between different threads. In addition, to further improve the time-marching efficiency in dealing with multiscale problems, the local time stepping (LTS) technique is exploited. To benchmark the efficiency and accuracy of the proposed parallel DGTD method, the scattering property of a stealthy aircraft model is investigated.

articleTitle: A Novel Dual Band Impedance Matching Network and Analysis of Matching Bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a novel dual band (DB) impedance matching network (IMN) with two transmission zeros (TZs) out-of-band is proposed. Two-section shunt transmission lines (TLs) is proposed to compensate susceptance of source admittance at dual operating frequencies. Another serial TL aims to modulate source conduction to target conduction <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$G_{0}$</tex>. Two TZs of arbitrary frequencies is imported by the two-stage TLs. Furthermore, the matching bandwidth (BW) of the proposed DB IMN has been analyzed.

articleTitle: A low phase noise FBAR voltage controlled oscillator design
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Using the designed high-Q thin-film acoustic wave resonator, a voltage-controlled oscillator with low phase noise and low power tunable frequency was designed, combined with tsmcN65 CMOS process. Firstly, the MBVD equivalent circuit model is applied to fit the designed high-Q FBAR resonator to obtain six circuit parameters. Then the circuit model is imported into Candence, and the FBAR voltage-controlled oscillator is designed based on the negative resistance principle. The resulting voltage-controlled oscillator has a center frequency of 2.742GHz, tuning bandwidth of 20MHz, phase noise of -144dBc/Hz@1MHz, power consumption of only 0.86mW, and FOM value of 213.4.

articleTitle: Semi-supervised Regression Model for Eye Diagram Estimation of High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) Silicon Interposer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a semi-supervised regression model for accurate eye height and eye width estimation of high bandwidth memory (HBM) silicon interposer channels. The model combines a channel characteristic-based deep neural network with a co-trained convolution neural network. For verification, the proposed model was applied to the stripline channels of an HBM silicon interposer. The root-mean-square errors (RMSE) of the predicted results of eye width and eye height are 4.95 mV and 7.32 ps.

articleTitle: Compact Model Library in Simscape for Various Memristors
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this work, a memristor compact model library based on Simscape language is proposed to bridge the gap between modeling and application of memristors. The library consists of six window function-based dopant drift models, the voltage-controlled VTEAM model, one HfOx-based memristor model, and the model of commercial KNOWM memristor. Then, a general method to model memristor using Simscape language is illustrated. Finally, some exemplary usage of the library is demonstrated by simulating the I-V characteristics and temperature variation of 1-transistor-1-memristor (1T1R) structure, and power consumption of the long-term potentiation and long-term depression (LTP/LTD) process of an artificial synapse. The library file is available for downloading and can be utilized in Simulink directly, which exhibits compatibility with the original components of Simulink and Simscape. This open-source project will be continuously updated to include the most representative models based on various memristors and theories.

articleTitle: Multi-Angle Monostatic RCS Regulation Based on Conformal Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this article, a new conformal metasurface that can realize directional radar cross section (RCS) modulation is designed. The metasurface is composed of target-shaped structural units. The design of the planar structure was completed according to Snell's theorem, and the overall structure was further optimized by algorithms taking into account the effect of the conformal phase distributions. Simulation results show that the designed metasurface can concentrate the scattered echoes into the −30°, 15°, −60°and 60° directions. By using this method, conformal metasurface can achieve various multi-angle RCS modulations through the design and algorithm optimization of different phases.

articleTitle: Research on Digitization of TWT Based on MTSS
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: To improve the ability of simulation analysis of travelling wave tube (TWT) simulation software and realize the design objectives of full data coverage, model feedback and model tuning, the digitization of TWT with Microwave Tube Simulator Suite (MTSS) as the core is studied in this paper. MTSS is driven by script to quickly establish co-simulation of the whole TWT, which can improve the ability of accurate simulation analysis of component and automatic optimization design of whole tube, shorten the design cycle of TWT and improve the comprehensive design level of TWT.

articleTitle: A RTC-DG Method for Electrical-Thermal-Stress Analysis of 3-D Packages of Integrated Circuits with Micro-Fluidic Cooling
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this work, a Robin transmission condition (RTC) augmented discontinuous Galerkin (DG) method (RTC-DG) is proposed for electrical-thermal-stress analysis of 3-D integrated circuits with micro-fluidic cooling. Unlike the conventional DG method, the proposed DG scheme is directly applied to discretize the high-order governing partial-differential equations (PDEs), and the resulted numerical flux is used for the information communication among neighboring subdomains. To strictly confine the new variables introduced by the numerical flux, a firstorder RTC is derived at the interface of adjacent subdomains, which serves as an auxiliary equation in helping solving the new variables. In such a way, it only needs to solve the newly introduced variables at the interface of subdomains, thus the number of degrees of freedoms (DoFs) is significantly reduced in comparison with the convential DG method. In addition, to keep the domain decomposition capability of the DG method for steady-state issues, a finite-element-tearing-and-interconnecting (FETI) like procedure is resorted to decomposed the globally-coupled matrix equation into a number of small matrix equations that can be parallely solved by a direct solver. To validate the accuracy and efficiency of proposed algorithm, the proposed RTC-DG method is applied to electrical-thermal-stress simulation for a 3-D package with micro-fluidic channel.

articleTitle: A New Numerical Flux in Discontinuous Galerkin Time- Domain Method for Tellegen Media
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The magneto electric coupling of Tellegen media makes formulating discontinuous Galerkin time-domain (DGTD) extensions a challenge. In this paper, we present a new upwind flux for Tellegen media. A novel DGTD formulation equipped with the new flux is presented to model the interaction of an electromagnetic wave with arbitrarily shaped three-dimensional Tellegen objects. The new upwind flux has been validated by means of numerical experiments and has shown good agreement.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Method for the Phase-Only Pattern Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this work, the inverse problem of pattern synthesis is solved with the neural network based on the prior knowledge of the array factor. The proposed method shows advantages of better accuracy and timeliness for large-scale phased arrays with the dimension of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$50\times 50$</tex>. The proposed method can be extended to the fields of beamforming, electromagnetic imaging and metasurface holography.

articleTitle: Research on Conducted Immunity Quantification Model of Operational Amplifier Based on Neural Networks and Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The quantitative model presented in this study focuses on analyzing and predicting the output behavior of conducted immunity operational amplifiers. By testing conducted immunity on operational amplifiers, a conducted immunity model is established using the time-domain waveform feature extraction and neural network method. The results demonstrate that the quantized model exhibits an error accuracy within 2 dB when compared to test data. Furthermore, the quantized model accurately predicts time-domain waveform features with an error accuracy within 1.2 dB.

articleTitle: A Single-port Dual-Band Dual-Pattern Metasurface Antenna Using Characteristic Mode Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A single-feed dual-band low-profile metasurface antenna capable of providing different radiation properties is designed in this paper for vehicle communication. The antenna is modeled, analyzed, and optimized using characteristic mode analysis (CMA) to understand the modal behavior of the metasurface and guide the mode excitation. The proposed antenna incorporates a square patch with a U-shaped and ring slots, which is directly excited by a coaxial probe to provide a directional radiation pattern at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{3.4GHz}$</tex>. Meanwhile, the peripheral four notched quarter-arc patches with shorting vias are energized by the probe under the coupling of the slot to produce an omnidirectional radiation pattern at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{2.4 \text{GHz}}$</tex>. The final design achieves a compact size <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{0.344 \lambda_0 * 0.344 \lambda_0 *} \mathbf{0.025 \lambda_0}$</tex> (where <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{\lambda_{0}}$</tex> is the free space wavelength at 2.4 GHz) and exhibits a −10 dB impedance bandwidth of 60 MHz and 200 MHz at the two operating bands. The peak gains at these frequencies are measured to be 2.7 dBi and 8.7 dBi, respectively.

articleTitle: 3-D-FDTD-PIC simulation of E-band Folded Waveguide Traveling Wave Tube
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper analyses the modeling and numerical simulation of an E-band folded waveguide traveling wave tube (FWG TWT) using the 3-D-FDTD-PIC parallel code. The cold test simulation of 10 ns time length requires only about 31 min and the hot test simulation can be realized accurately within 43 min. For 3-D-FDTD-PIC hot test simulations, electron bunching and particle velocity modulation phenomenon are observed clearly in the FWG TWT. Moreover, the maximum error of the simulated power in the frequency range from 81 GHz to 87 GHz is only 0.31 dB. Combing with our previous work on helix TWT, the present work well demonstrates the generality of 3-D-FDTD-PIC code for the simulation of different types of TWTs.

articleTitle: Partially Coating Approach for Reducing Backscattering from Cavity
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Cavities are strong scattering parts for aircrafts. The whole cavity interior surface is usually coated for reducing cavity backscattering. In this paper, we present an efficient scheme by just coating partial interior surface. A discontinuous Galerkin (DG) method based on the self-dual integral equation (SDIE) is employed to investigate scattering from partially coated cavity. The numerical result of typical S-shaped cavity proves that the proposed coating scheme can achieve similar backscattering reduction but uses smaller coated interior surface region.

articleTitle: Design of an Optically Transparent Transmitarray Based on Huygens' Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A novel optically transparent transmitarray based on double-layer Huygens' metasurface is proposed by combining fine metal lines and optically transparent polyethylene terephthalate (PET) and cyclic olefin copolymer (COC) dielectric substrates. The top and bottom metal lines on COC substrate simultaneously function as electric and magnetic dipoles, inducing orthogonal electric and magnetic currents. At the center frequency of 33 GHz, the transmission loss and phase shift of the proposed transmitarray element are <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\sim \mathbf{0.83}\quad \mathbf{dB}$</tex> and 334°, respectively. The transmitarray has a high gain of 25.3 dBi, leading to a high aperture efficiency of 47%.

articleTitle: Temperature inversion and infrared characterization of snow surface in Tibetan region based on thermal infrared remote sensing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Snow is most widely distributed in the cryosphere and is one of the most active natural elements on the earth's surface. In this paper, based on MODIS (Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer) remote sensing data, the improved split-window algorithm is used to invert the snow surface temperature in Tibetan region, and a self-programmed Matlab program is used to complete the study of the infrared radiation characteristics of the snow surface. The remote sensing images of the characteristic date of 2020 are selected, and the inversion results are compared with the GLDAS-2.1 snow temperature product for verification. The results show that the errors between the observed and inversion values are stable in the range of 2-4K, and complete the investigation of the infrared characteristic law of snow environment at interannual scale. This study can provide an accurate, effective and fast means to monitor the parameters of snow environment in Tibetan region.

articleTitle: Study on Scattering Characteristics of Plasma-Coated 2D Cylinder in Terahertz Band by Wave Equation-Based DGTD Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Terahertz (THz) waves have better penetration ability than microwaves, and thus have always been considered as an effective way to solve the black barrier problem. In this work, a wave equation-based discontinuous Galerkin time-domain (DGTD-WE) method is developed to simulate the scattering characteristics of a plasma-coated 2D Cylinder in the THz band. The auxiliary differential equation (ADE) technique is used to describe the dispersion properties of plasma to construct the system governing equation. Numerical results demonstrate the effectiveness of the DGTD-WE method. Moreover, the effects of plasma frequency, collision frequency, and plasma thickness on the scattering characteristics are discussed.

Author Keywords: wave equation-based discontinuous Galerkin time-domain (DGTD-WE) method

articleTitle: Simulation Study on Radiation Emission of Power Conversion System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, the radiation emission (RE) simulation and prediction model are established for the analysis of the electromagnetic interference (EMI) generated by the inverter module in a power conversion system (PCS). Firstly, according to the principle of electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), the mechanism of the RE in the PCS is analyzed. Secondly, the three-dimensional equivalent model of the PCS is built in HFSS software, and the ports are set and analyzed according to the actual working conditions. Using the field-circuit coupling simulation technology to obtain the actual excitation of each port, which can realize the simulated prediction of the radiated signals. Lastly, compared with the simulation results and measured results, it shows that the two results change synchronously and verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning-Based Pin Map Optimization of BGA Package for EMC
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The radiation from the solder balls in the Ball Grid Array (BGA) packaging has become one of the main sources of electromagnetic leaks, and the pin mapping significantly impacts the package's electromagnetic compatibility (EMC). In this paper, a deep reinforcement learning (DRL)-based pin distribution optimization is proposed. Combined with the VBGT-Matrix fast calculation method, it can learn the radiation characteristics of various environments through self-training and then produce targeted pin map solutions. The outcome demonstrates that the optimization algorithm has fast speed and low power consumption, verifying the design expertise of the present industry and providing additional design insights.

articleTitle: Design of Miniaturized Equal-Phase Dual-Band Branch Line Coupler for GNSS Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In the paper, a miniaturized dual-band branch line coupler (BLC) with equal phase difference is designed for GNSS applications. The dual-band equal phase response is realized by replacing the BL in the coupler by open/short stub loaded transmission line (TL). Besides, by using the stub loaded TL, small frequency ratio of around 1.3 can be realized. Parameter relationships between the BL and the open/short stub loaded TL are given and a prototype operating at dual GNSS bands was designed. For easy integrated with the antenna, the BLC is folded without affecting the original performance, and mender lines are used for implementing the open/short stub loaded TL. The size of the fabricated prototype is 0.3λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</inf>× 0.3λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</inf>. Measurement results show that the bandwidths at lower and higher GNSS frequencies are 14.1% and 15.4%, respectively, under the criterion of 10- dB return loss. For 1-dB amplitude imbalance and 10° phase difference error, the measured bandwidths are 14.9% and 9.6%, separately.

articleTitle: Design of Miniaturized On-Chip Diamond Grid Antenna Based on CMOS 65nm Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: On-chip antenna is a crucial module in the integrated RF chip systems, which is used to receive and transmit wireless signals. However, the miniaturization technology of on-chip antenna is still a challenging issue. To alleviate this issue, a compact 94 GHz on-chip diamond grid antenna based on CMOS 65 nm technology is presented in this work. Specifically, to enhance the performance of proposed antenna, a power distribution network is used as the excited device, and an imaginary ground plane is constructed to achieve the function of image antenna for improving the gain. The simulated results show the return loss lower than −10 dB from 91.6 GHz to 98.5 GHz (i.e. 7.22 % relative bandwidth with the operating central frequency being 94.8 GHz). Meanwhile, the efficiency and peak gain of the proposed on-chip antenna are 96.6% and 5.2dB, respectively. Compared with the traditional rectangular-based GAA, the size of the proposed antenna is reduced by one-third. It is expected that the proposed on-chip diamond GAA is able to be used as a suitable candidate for 94 GHz wireless applications.

articleTitle: Loop Electric Dipole Array Antenna with Switchable Endfire Beam
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a novel loop electric dipole array antenna with switchable endfire beam is designed for ever-increasing demand of multibeam antenna systems. By properly designing the structure of a four-leaf-clover-shaped patch and the positions of two feeding ports, the loop electric dipole array antenna can work in a frequency band with bandwidth of 13.23% (5.3GHz <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$6.04 \text{GGz})$</tex>. The maximum gain within the frequency band is 2.80 dBi. The designed planar loop electric dipole array antenna can switch its endfire beam between two azimuthal angles when exciting the two ports individually, which is applicable to radio wave coverage in one-dimensional confined space.

articleTitle: A Miniaturized UWB TEM Horn Antenna Design
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, an UWB TEM horn antenna in the form of a combined oscillator is designed. On the basis of the TEM horn antenna with exponential changes in both impedance and board spacing, the end of the horn antenna is bent and extended in reverse, and then connected with the metal board loaded with S-shaped structure at the back end to form a closed loop, thereby improving the matching performance at low frequencies. In addition, the matching strip is loaded between the TEM horn surface and the parallel boards, which further optimizes the matching performance at low frequencies, thereby realizing the miniaturization of the antenna. The size of the antenna is about <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$218.41\ \text{mm}\ (\text{opening})\times 100\ \text{mm}\ (\text{axial})\times 97.45\ \text{mm}$</tex> (width), and the simulation results show that the VSWR in 0.38-10 GHz is less than 2 and the average gain in the band is about 9 dBi.

articleTitle: A Few-shot learning SAR image generative model for automatic target recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A new Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) image generative model is proposed for efficiently solving the recognition tasks in few-shot learning. In order to further improve SAR image quality and variety, the advantages of the two types of traditional generative models are combined, parts of their structure are used to stitch together into a novel generative model. An intuitive representation is the series connection between Variational Auto-encoder (VAE) and discriminator (Dis), the former is used to generate images and the latter is used to judge the generated images and the real images. Numerical results show that the image quality and variety can be improved significantly by the proposed VAE-Dis method with encouraging accuracy in the identification tasks.

articleTitle: A Broadband Dual Polarization Probe with Slot for Millimeter-Wave Measurement System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, We presented a novel dual-polarized quad-ridged dual-polarized horn antenna (QRHA) used as a probe in near-field measurement system application. The electromagnetic simulation software HFSS is used to simulate the antenna modeling and structure. From the characterization result, The horn antenna operating band is 5-50GHz, covering the band of 5G communication. The design procedure of quad-ridged horn demonstrates that shaping the stepped sidewalls of the horn significantly improves the radiation characteristics of the horn. As the frequency increased, the antenna radiation direction map has no obvious cleavage in the whole frequency band. The typical value of two orthogonal port isolation and cross-polarization is more than 30dB, which can maintain stable radiation performance and has certain reference value for engineering design.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of Radar Low Scattering Objects
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A Low Scattering Object (LSO) design and optimization method based on NURBS curves is proposed. NURBS curves can be fitted to arbitrary curves with different parameters, and can be extended for parametric object design; A surrogate model is constructed to replace the real electromagnetic scattering model to realize rapid prediction and optimization of Radar Cross Section (RCS). This method achieved a reduction of 13.83dBsm in the P-band for a given object.

articleTitle: Transient Thermal Simulation of 2.5-D Integrated System by Laguerre-Based DGTD Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a Laguerre-based discontinuous Galerkin time domain (LBDGTD) method for transient thermal simulation of 2.5-D integrated systems. The proposed method eliminates the time variable by employing weighted Laguerre polynomials as the temporal basis functions. With the Galerkin temporal test procedure, a set of recursive linear equations is derived. This algorithm inherits the element-level domain decomposition property from discontinuous Galerkin time domain (DGTD) method. Furthermore, as a march-on-in-order algorithm, LBDGTD is not subject to the restrictions imposed by the Courant–Friedrichs–Lewy (CFL) condition. A numerical example verifies the precision and efficiency of the LBDGTD.

articleTitle: A Novel TBD Method for Non-Cooperative Bistatic Radar Based on Kernel Correlation Filtering
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Non-cooperative bistatic radar has problems with low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and unstable detection in target detection, posing challenges to the traditional detect-before-track (DBT) method. Although the track-before-detect (TBD) is one of the effective ways to solve the above problems, it still faces the problem of processing large amounts of data. To address this problem, this paper proposes a novel TBD method that combines kernel correlation filtering (KCF) technology with computer vision. In this method, the peak sidelobe ratio (PSR) is used as the evaluation index of the value function and tracking stability. At the same time, in order to solve the problem of drift and loss in target tracking, track prediction technology is also introduced into this method. Through the verification of the measured data, the new method in this paper not only has a good tracking effect, but also has a significant improvement compared with dynamic programming track-before-detect (DP-TBD).

articleTitle: A Miniaturized All-Metal Dual-Polarized Antenna Array with Heat Dissipation Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a miniaturized all-metal dualpolarized antenna array with heat dissipation enhancement is proposed for base station application. The size of the antenna array is 3x3 with its vertical spacing 77 mm and horizontal spacing 53 mm. The radiator is bent vertically to realize the miniaturization of the antenna without sacrificing original electromagnetic performance. The antenna operates in the band of 2496 MHz to 2690 MHz with an electrical down-tilting of 6°±1°. Due to the advantage of the all-metal design of the antenna, it has stronger heat dissipation performance in the natural thermal simulation environment compared with the ordinary dipole antenna array printed on the dielectric plate.

articleTitle: Application of Superconducting Materials in Tunable Spatial Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A tunable spatial filtering structure was designed, which consists of periodically arranged resonant units made of superconducting materials. Based on the special resistance characteristics of superconducting materials, the resistivity of resonant components after quenching will change with changes in applied current intensity, magnetic field intensity, or working environment temperature, thus achieving tuning of filtering characteristics without changing the structural shape.

articleTitle: A Forward Established Attributed Scattering Center Model for Dynamic Group Targets
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper proposes a forward method for establishing a attributed scattering center model of group target. The main steps can be divided into CAD model preprocessing and scattering center parameter extraction. This method can efficiently and automatically identify and explain the scattering mechanism of scattering centers and calculate relevant parameters. This method is of great significance for target recognition and electromagnetic camouflage.

articleTitle: Simulation of Manual Gain Control of Geosynchronous Orbit SAR
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: To simulate the MGC parameters of GEO SAR, this paper first demonstrate the trajectory and satellite-ground relationship, then, the scattering characteristics of typical natural scenes are established by using the real Digital Elevation Model (DEM) and the physical optics algorithm. The MGC parameters are obtained by the radar equation, the MGC parameters of GEO SAR are finally designed based on the simulation results

articleTitle: Effects of Different Lower Ionospheric Models on the Calculation of Low-Frequency Sky Waves
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Ionosphere features influenced the propagation of a low-frequency (LF) signal in the Earth-Ionospheric Waveguide (EIWG). In this letter, the sky wave reflection coefficients are calculated using several ionospheric models. comparisons are made of the effects of latitude and diurnal variation on the reflection coefficient separately. At low latitudes, the reflection coefficient of the low ionosphere is greater than at middle latitudes. The simulation results can serve as a theoretical reference for the subsequent analysis of the measured signals.

articleTitle: Parallel Coupled Microstrip Wideband Bandpass Filter Loaded with CSRR and SRR Structures
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a parallel coupled line bandpass filter for X-band applications, which has low insertion loss, broadband and easy processing. By loading the CSRR (Complementary Split Ring Resonator) and SRR (Split Ring Resonator) structures, three additional transmission zeros are added to improve the out-of-band rejection performance of the filter. Moreover, the rectangular DGS structure below the triple-parallel coupling line reduces the insertion loss of the filter. The simulation results show that the filter center frequency is 9.5GHz, the insertion loss is 0.8dB, S11<-12.3dB, and the relative bandwidth is 20.2%.

articleTitle: A Design of Optically Transparent Reflectarray Based on ITO Material
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A novel optically transparent reflectarray based on indium tin oxide (ITO) material is proposed in this paper. The reflectarray is composed of an ITO patch, two quartz glass substrates, and an ITO ground. By introducing an air gap between the quartz glass substrates, multi-layered hybrid dielectrics are formed, reducing the high conductor loss of the ITO material. The element employs a combination of the “single-resonance mode” and “multi-resonance mode” to achieve a broader range of phase variation. At the center frequency of 20 GHz, the proposed reflectarray element owns a reflection loss of less than 1.8 dB and a phase variation of 494°, and the reflectarray can achieve a gain of 24.4 dBi.

articleTitle: Hybrid MPIE Method with Anisotropic Impedance Boundary Conditions for Layered Media
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A mixed potential integral equation (MPIE) method combined with anisotropic impedance boundary conditions is proposed for the analysis of scattering from layered media. In this method, anisotropic surface conductivity is modeled by the impedance boundary conditions. As a result, only these surfaces need to be discretized. Numerical example is demonstrated to show the accuracy of this method.

articleTitle: A 1-bit Metasurface Design for Millimeter-Wave Holographic Imaging Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper develops a programmable metasurface for holographic imaging application in millimeter-wave regime. The 1-bit metasurface unit cell integrated with two PIN diodes has been designed. By simultaneously switching two PIN diodes from ON state to OFF state, the reflection phase difference is approximately 180° with the reflection magnitude better than -2 dB. Based on Gerchberg-Saxton (GS) algorithm and Raleigh-Sommerfeld optical diffraction theory, 1-bit metasurface unit cells are arranged into a metasurface array. Numerical results are given to demonstrate that the proposed metasurface array achieves good holographic imaging of different letters by dynamically changing the phase encodings on the array, providing a promising solution for high-resolution and high-fidelity image reconstruction.

articleTitle: Dual Holographic Reflective Metasurface System for Beam Conversion
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this article, a dual holographic reflective metasurface system is proposed for achieving flexible beam conversion. Holographic reflective metasurface A is designed to generate a multimode orbital angular momentum (OAM) vortex wave as the primary beamforming stage. Subsequently, holographic metasurface <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{B}$</tex> is utilized to transform the multimode OAM vortex wave into two spherical waves with different modes, constituting the secondary beamforming stage. Through simulation, we have successfully demonstrated the attainability of the aforementioned beamforming capability at 10 GHz.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis on Parameter Estimation of Orthogonal Matching Pursuit Based on the Attribute Scattering Center Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Parameter estimation of the scatters based on the attributed Scattering Center (ASC) model is a hot research topic in feature extraction field, which is widely used in artificial intelligential target recognition. However, different measured data of a same target will produce different estimated error variances. Therefore, having a knowledge of the limit bound of performance of different parameter estimation methods on measured data of different qualities will help the researchers to reasonably design experiments and wisely process data. This article will give a shot introduction of how to evaluate the performance of data measured in different dimension. Besides, Orthogonal Matching Pursuit (OMP) which is one of those inversion methods in parameter estimation will help to verify the accuracy of our theory. In this paper we will derive a Cramer-Rao Lower Bound (CRLB) formula used for simulated radar data and use it as a benchmark [1] to calculate the data accuracy limit bound.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Electromagnetic Radiation from Vehicle Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Electromagnetic radiation from body controller module antenna is simulated and analysed using FEKO. According to the directional diagram of the antenna to verify the rationality of the antenna design, to ensure that the antenna meets the requirements of practical applications, and also based on the simulation results of the electric field inside the car to analyze the electromagnetic radiation of the body controller module antenna inside the car body.

articleTitle: Dynamic Electro- Thermo- Migration Coupling Analysis of RDL Structure for 2.5D Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents dynamic electro-thermo, electromigration (EM) and thermomigration (TM) coupling analysis of the redistribution layer (RDL) for 2.5D integration. Based on multiple time scales of transient multiphysics simulation, we find that the time scale of electromigration stress is much larger than that of thermal and electrical fields. Therefore, we can perform steady-state analysis for thermal and electrical field, and carry out transient analysis for EM stress field to solve the multiscale problems. We explore the impact of dynamical current density on EM stress relaxation (EM recovery) phenomenon. Furthermore, the reservoir and bend of RDL structure are also studied to figure out the relationship between them and EM stress. The numerical results show that the temperature gradients and reservoir can improve the EM lifetime, but the bend can accelerate the EM agine.

articleTitle: FDTD Method for Calculating Transient Responses of Twisted-Wire Pairs above Ground
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method for transmission line equations in Taylor field-to-wire coupling form is adopt to calculate the transient response of twisted-wire pairs (TWP) above perfect electric conductor (PEC) ground plane. First, the proposed method is verified by comparing the results with CST. Then, the terminal response of TWP under dual-exponential pulse wave irradiation is compared with CST, validating the accuracy of the proposed method. Last, the terminal voltage and current responses of the TWP are analyzed with different incident wave directions.

articleTitle: Decoupling Design Based on Metasurface Superstrate for Millimeter Wave Antennas
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A high port isolation millimeter wave antenna array with compact size is proposed in this paper. The center distance between the two E-shaped patches is only 3.2mm, about 0.28 wavelength at center frequency, which will generate a strong mutual coupling. In order to suppress the coupling, a metasurface superstrate consisting of the split-ring resonators is designed, which is placed on the top of the antenna element. The simulation results show that the port isolation of the decoupled antenna array can be improved to over 25dB in the operating frequency range of 24.25-27.5GHz, which demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed decoupling method.

articleTitle: Design of a Wide Frequency Selective Rasorber with Switchable Transmission/Reflection Band
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a wide frequency selective rasorber(FSR) with switchable transmission/reflection band is proposed. The FSR mainly consists of an impedance surface layer and two active frequency selective surface(AFSS) layers. The upper impedance surface layer provides a wide absorption band, whereas PIN diodes are mounted in the bottom layers to enable the switching operation of the transmission/reflection at P and L band. Compared with the published FSRs, the biggest advantage of the proposed structure is that when the PIN diodes are in the OFF state, it can maintain a passband performance of more than 80% in the P and L band. When the PIN diodes are in the ON state, the reflection coefficient is more than -0.2dB in the P and L band, and the transmittance is less than 6% from P to Ku band. Moreover, no matter what state the PIN diodes are in, the designed structure can maintain a stable absorption performance of more than 80% from X to Ku band.

articleTitle: Parallel HSS Based Fast Direct Surface Integral Equation Solver for Computing Scattering by Cavities
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: We present in this paper an HSS (Hierarchically Semiseparable) matrix based fast direct surface integral equation solver for computing electromagnetic scattering by cavities. In the proposed solver, the poor conditioned dense matrix equations system of surface integral equation (SIE) for a cavity is solved by using accuracy-controllable HSS direct solver. This HSS based fast direct SIE solver is parallelized to further improve its computational capability. Numerical experiments demonstrate the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed method for nonuniform deep and large cavities.

articleTitle: A Novel Wideband Stacked Patch Filtering Antenna with Multiple Slots for Selectivity and Bandwidth Improvement
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a novel double-layer filtering antenna embedded multiple slots, short-circuit probe and Defected Ground Structure (DGS) is proposed. The antenna produces four radiation zeros to obtain quasi-elliptical band-pass response. The simulation results show that the impedance bandwidth of the antenna is 23.2% (4.25 ~ 5.41GHz), the realized gain at the center frequency is 9.7dBi, the out-of-band rejection is greater than 21 dB. The selectivity indicators are F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">L</inf>=0.16 and Fu=0.42. The upper and lower edge radiation zeros of the working band greatly improve the selectivity of the filtering antenna. The proposed filtering antenna has the advantages of multiple radiation zeros, high selectivity, wide band and good rejection level.

articleTitle: Coplanar Waveguide-fed Low-profile Back Cover Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper proposes two novel low-profile antennas, printed on the back cover of a cellular device and fed through a coplanar waveguide (CPW). The impact of the battery on the antenna's performance is considered. Simulation results demonstrate a wide operational bandwidth of over 1.3 GHz, covering the 3.3-3.6 GHz and B7 bands. Furthermore, the antennas' placement on the device's back cover enables an impressively low profile, offering significant potential for 5G communication technology in the future.

articleTitle: Design of Low RCS Conformal Discone Antenna Applied to Low-Observable Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The antenna usually needs to be embedded into the cavity to achieve a conformal design with the stealth platform, but it often destroys the stealth of the platform. In this paper, a discone antenna is designed, which has good end-fire and omnidirectional radiation performance. The radar cross section (RCS) of the platform is studied after placing the antenna in the cavity of the platform. Through cavity and antenna shape modification, the radar cross section (RCS) reduction can be realized. The effectiveness of the measures is verified by simulation software.

articleTitle: A Novel DME Pulse Waveform for EMC Optimization with L-DACS1
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The development, testing, and performance verification of Distance Measuring Equipment (DME) use signals in Gaussian double pulse modulation format. In addition, L-band Digital Aeronautical Communications System 1 (L-DACS1) is a candidate technology for the future ground-to-air data chain for aviation communication, and DME is its main source of interference. In this paper, smooth trapezoidal pulse waveform is proposed, which can guarantee the ranging performance of DME and provide lower interference than conventional Gaussian pulses to further improve the electromagnetic compatibility with the L-DACS1 system. The alternative pulse waveform conforms to the pulse shape requirements in the current DME specification to maintain compatibility with existing DME ground transponders and avionics. The pulse signal proposed in this paper solves the spectral over-widening problem caused by a too-fast rising edge. Therefore, even when transmitting at the same high power of 1000 Watts as conventional Gaussian pulses, the interference to adjacent channels is very small. In this paper, under the background of the coexistence of DME and L-DACS1 systems, it is verified that smooth trapezoidal pulse modulation signals can effectively improve the electromagnetic compatibility of the two and improve the transmission performance of the system.

articleTitle: Radius Error Effect Studies of Bipolar Spherical Resonator Cavity on SLED
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The bipolar spherical cavity SLED has been widely used in accelerator and high power microwave fields as it has high quality factor and is much tighter in volume than the traditional structure. However, due to its high compactness, small radius changes will lead to significant changes in the system's performance. Therefore, we study the radius error effects of the bipolar spherical resonator on SLED through theoretical analysis and numerical simulation. We conclude that if the radius of the sphere is symmetrically larger or smaller only on the axis of mode rotation, the resonant frequency of the spherical cavity will be correspondingly smaller or larger, and the change of the radius will not cause reflection. However, when the radius of the sphere changes asymmetrically perpendicular to the axis of mode rotation, the two degenerate modes will resonate at different frequencies. Due to the characteristics of the dual polarized coupler in this case, obvious reflection will appear and this could reduce the working performance of SLED seriously.

articleTitle: Vortex Wave Multi-Mode OAM Spectrum Conversion Method Through Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Electromagnetic vortex waves carrying orbital angular momentum (OAM) can be used for information multiplexing transmission or coded modulation, which can meet the requirements of large capacity and high rate wireless communication. In this paper, the metasurface with independent amplitude and phase manipulation ability is proposed as the OAM mode converter of the vortex wave with multiple OAM modes, and the feasibility of this method is proved by simulation verification. This method can not only realize the OAM mode spectrum conversion from single mode to multiple modes, but also the conversion from multiple modes OAM spectrum to another different OAM spectrum, and for the converted OAM spectrum, the isolations between the main OAM modes and the crosstalk OAM mode is more than 10dB, with a good isolation performance.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable Feed Network For Multi-Polar Antennas
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A reconfigurable feed network for multi-polar antennas is proposed in this article. It uses PIN diodes to make reconfigurable structure and change the output. The network can produce four kinds of output signal with only one input port. It has four output ports with specific phase delay, which uses differential-feed to suppress cross polarization. The simulated results show that the operating frequency range of the feed network is about 2.5-3.5 GHz with good matching and isolation performance. The variable polarization and wide band make it be a good choice for late-model multi-polar antennas with both linear and circular polarization.

articleTitle: An All-Metal Wide-Band High-Gain Leaky-Wave Antenna with Wide Scanning Range
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: An all-metal wide-band high-gain leaky-wave antenna (LWA) with wide scanning range is presented in this article. A rectangular waveguide loaded with two rows of glidesymmetry serrated stubs is introduced as the basic transmission structure to realize a lossless and wideband transmission. In addition, totally 38 glide-symmetry longitudinal slots arranged on top of the waveguide is adopted as the radiated elements. The developed leaky-wave antenna can operate from 23 to 43 GHz with a 60.6% bandwidth, and can realize a scanning range of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$80^{\circ}$</tex> between <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$-57^{\circ}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$23^{\circ}$</tex> with a peak gain of 20 dBi at 32 GHz.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Reconstruction Accuracy of Compact Polarized SAR Pseudo Quad-Pol Data for Use in Ocean Surface Observations
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper assesses the capability of Compact Polarized (CP) Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) to explore ocean surface backscattering by reconstructing the pseudo quad-pol data. Besides using Souyris or Nord algorithms, 8 scenes of Radarsat-2 quad-polarized images are used to develop an empirical model for estimating the initial value of N in Collins's algorithm. The robustness the three published algorithms are discussed together with the reconstruction error of polarization scattering matrix [S]. The comparisons show that Collins's algorithm is superior to the other two algorithms in terms of reconstruction errors for the HH, VV, especially, the HV channels. In addition, the influence of each algorithm on polarimetric parameters is investigated. Based on the retrieval of the polarimetric parameters, it is concluded that Souyris, Nord and Collins algorithms all have similar (high) accuracies for copolarization backscattering coefficient σ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup><inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">HH</inf>, σ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup><inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">vv</inf>, co-polarization correlation coefficient <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$p$</tex> and first eigenvalue l<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>, while for cross-polarization backscattering coefficient σ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup><inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">vv</inf> and scattering angle α, the accuracy of Collins's algorithm performs better than that of Souyris or Nord. Although all three algorithms produced low accuracies for second eigenvalue <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$l$</tex><inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, third eigenvalue l<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, scattering entropy <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$H$</tex> and scattering anisotropy A, the results obtained using Collins algorithm were better than those produced by the other two algorithms.

articleTitle: Design of Dielectric-Loaded Antenna Array with Multi-Objective Surrogate Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: When applied to the design of high-gain high-bandwidth orbital-angular-momentum (OAM) antennas loaded by substrates, the full-wave analysis suffers from drawbacks such as low efficiency and extended period for parameter scanning. We propose a surrogate model based on a back propagation neural network (BPNN) to improve the efficiency of parameter scanning and the design process. Compared to the traditional single-objective surrogate model for the return loss function, the proposed BPNN-based model is a multi-objective surrogate model for a simplified S-matrix ignoring mutual coupling effects between non-adjacent antenna elements. During the establishment process, the surrogate model must undergo multiple iterations of genetic algorithm (GA) optimization and calibration through full-wave analysis, with mean absolute percentage errors (MAPE) being the calibration standard. After employing it in a dielectric-loaded uniform circular array of six rectangular patches, the design based on the surrogate model can significantly reduce training time and the MAPE by less than 2.5%. The method can accelerate the construction of dielectric-loaded planar antenna arrays for various applications in communication systems.

articleTitle: Intelligent Design of Metamaterial Absorber Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a deep learning method is proposed to predict the absorption of metamaterial absorber (MMA) in real time, and then the Binary Particle Swarm Optimization (BPSO) method is introduced to cooperate with the deep learning prediction model to design MMA in a few seconds. The experimental result shows that the proposed method in this paper can achieve an absorption above 90% over the broadband of 7.0-16.8GHz with a prediction accuracy of 96.47%.

articleTitle: Dual-Band Coding Metasurface Design Based on Transmission and Reflection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a metasurface that can work at different frequencies is proposed. The proposed metasurface has good transmission performance at 9.5GHz-10.5GHz, and the transmission amplitude more than 0.4. At 25GHz-30GHz the reflection amplitude is maintained above 0.8 and at 28GHz it reaches 0.95. Metasurface element shows excellent transmission and reflection properties. In order to realize the function of metasurface array, the different phases of the elements are arranged in the code. Arraying metasurface elements can realize transmission focusing functions in the low frequency and reflected beam splitting in the high frequency. The array achieves good working performance. It has potential applications in imaging and communication systems.

articleTitle: Power Noise Suppression Using Power-and-Ground via Pairs for Signal and Power Integrity
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a simultaneous switching noise suppression method combining Electromagnetic Bandgap (EBG) and power-and-ground via pairs is proposed. This structure is partially etched only in the noise source and sensitive circuit parts on the plane, without using a bridge structure. In terms of multiple layers, it is connected through a thin dielectric and via arrays. Compared to the traditional EBG structure, this structure ensures excellent noise suppression capability while maintaining pretty signal integrity and power integrity. Simulation results demonstrate that this structure possesses better signal integrity and power integrity with a steep suppression level of −40dB from 1.61 to 15GHz

articleTitle: Inversion of Planetary Surface Dielectric Parameters Based on Hybrid High Frequency Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper proposes a method for accurately inverting the dielectric parameters of rough surfaces using a hybrid high-frequency electromagnetic model. The root-mean-square error (RMSE) of the RCS is used as the objective function, and the hybrid model of the physical optics method (PO) and the integral equation method (IEM) is used as the RCS numerical solver. The accuracy of the RCS simulation using the PO-IEM model is validated by comparing it with the FEKO method of moments. The RCS error is is found to be less than 4 dB and the efficiency is improved by 20000 times. This demonstrates that the model not only provides accurate scattering characteristics calculations but also significantly enhances the efficiency of the genetic algorithm iteration optimization process. This article performs dielectric parameter inversion on both rough planes and rough crater structures with varying roughness and dielectric parameters. The average error of the dielectric parameters is found to be less than 9%. These findings highlight the practical value of the proposed inversion method in engineering applications, particularly in remote sensing technologies such as soil moisture detection and the extraction of dielectric parameters for planetary surfaces.

articleTitle: EM Simulation and Mechanism Analysis of Dielectric Coated Complex Target Based on MoM-PO Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Based on the impedance boundary condition (IBC), the paper firstly proposes a MoM-PO hybrid algorithm for high-precision and rapid prediction of electromagnetic (EM) scattering of dielectric-coated complex targets. Aiming at the difficult problems of scattering sources and mechanism analysis of complex targets, a set of scattering source analysis methods based on component decomposition is proposed. The article takes the B-2 Ghost strategic bomber as an example. The simulation results are in good agreement with the exact solution. The in-depth analysis of the scattering mechanism of the target under the three conditions of ideal conductivity, overall dielectric coating and partial dielectric coating verifies the engineering application value of the research content of the article.

articleTitle: Polynomial Chaos-Based Yield Optimization of Three-Pole H-Plane Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Yield optimization aims to find high-yield designs of microwave components under the uncertainties in the production process. However the Monte Carlo-based yield optimization requires extensive electromagnetic (EM) simulations. In this paper, the polynomial chaos (PC) expansion is used to construct the surrogate model of the EM responses. By combining the PC coefficients with the objective function, the objective function is related to the optimization variable. This approach allows for reliable yields and uses fewer EM simulations compared to the Monte Carlo-based yield optimization method.

articleTitle: An Efficient and Accurate SIE Formulation with Loop Analysis for Arbitrary-Shaped Interconnects
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A novel method is proposed for extracting the impedance of interconnects in packages. This method uses the magneto-quasi-static (MQS) surface integral equation (SIE) formulation with loop analysis. By using graph theory, the loop analysis is developed with a set of unknowns that are independent and complete, which can reduce the complexity of the final matrix equation. The pre-corrected fast Fourier Transform (pFFT) algorithm is carried out to speed up the matrix-vector product. To validate the proposed method, a real-life example in packages is presented. The results show that the proposed method can accurately and flexibly model complex interconnects in packages compared to the existing industrial solver.

articleTitle: NESA-VIE for Electromagnetic Analysis of Inhomogeneous Dielectrics
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a nested equivalent source approximation-volume integral equation (NESA-VIE) algorithm for matrix low-rank compression to analyze the electromagnetic scattering problem of inhomogeneous dielectrics. Unlike SIE, VIE introduces the dielectric contrast to reflect the difference of dielectric constants in different parts of the object, so it can be used to model and analyze inhomogeneous dielectrics. In the framework of NESA, the original volume integral matrix equation is now decomposed into the product of the radiation matrix ‘V’ of the RWG -to-SWG interaction, the translation matrix ‘D’ and the receiving matrix ‘U’ of the SWG-to-RWG interaction, thus reducing the memory and computation. The construction of ‘U’ and ‘V’ mentioned above is modified to compress VIE rather than SIE in the original NESA. Numerical results of RCS calculation show the correctness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Neural Network-Based Algorithm for Detecting Key Parts of Vehicles in SAR Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In recent years, the application of neural networks in Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) image processing has made important progress. A large amount of work has proven that object recognition neural networks designed for optical images also can be used for SAR images. However, there is relatively little discussion on the detection of key parts of vehicle targets based on neural networks. This article further studies the detection algorithm for key parts on the basis of existing object recognition methods for SAR images. A large number of vehicle SAR images are simulated and annotated as a dataset for network training and testing. This article uses Feature Pyramid Network (FPN) as the backbone network, which is the foundation of multi-scale object recognition. Two task specialized subnetworks attached to the backbone network respectively achieve classification and locating functions. The Vehicle Classification Neural Network (VCNN) and the Vehicles' Key Parts Detection Neural Network (VKDNN) are trained separately. Every image is first processed by the VCNN, and then the decision is made on whether to input it into the VKDNN and obtain the results. In this dataset, each image takes 0.129 seconds to be detected on average, and the key parts recognition accuracy is 91.12% in the entire dataset. Good results have been obtained in terms of detection efficiency and accuracy.

articleTitle: Full-Wave Equivalent Circuit Characterization for Large-Scale Microstrip Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A full-wave equivalent circuit characterization strategy for large-scale microstrip transmission lines is presented based on the partial element equivalent circuit (PEEC) method. Specifically, the multilayered Green's functions are derived from the discrete complex-image method (DCIM), which consist of the quasi-static, surface-wave and complex images components. Considering time delays caused by electromagnetic wave propagation, the proposed full-wave strategy combined with PEEC can extract the equivalent circuit parameters efficiently, which provides clear physical insights, facilitating the field-circuit co-simulation and optimization. Finally, some numerical results are given to show the efficiency and accuracy of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: An Effective RCS Data Compression and Prediction Strategy Based on Scattering Center Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, an effective RCS data compression and interpolation prediction method has been proposed. Proved the advantages of the scattering center model in storing echo data. In addition, an adaptive interpolation algorithm was proposed to predict scattering center parameters. The ball-plate model verifies the effectiveness of this strategy. The numerical simulation results show that interpolation prediction has high accuracy, which can significantly reduce the computational complexity required in the database construction process.

articleTitle: Experimental Validation of the Embedded Anisotropic Thin Layer Model in the Massively Parallel Computer Codes JEMS-FDTD
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: An embedded anisotropic thin layer model, based on the extended subgridding boundary condition (SGBC) technique, has been developed and integrated into the massively parallel computer codes JEMS-FDTD for efficient simulation of electrically large objects with anisotropic thin layers.
