Meanwhile, the resonant mechanism is analyzed by surface current distribution and equivalent circuit model (ECM). Finally, a sample is fabricated, and the experimental results in a microwave anechoic chamber are in good agreement with numerical analysis.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Based Channel Parameter Prediction Method Utilizing Ray Tracing Simulation Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Accurate channel models are essential to the evaluation and optimization deployment of mobile communication systems, especially with the development of next generation of mobile communication, which has raised the accuracy demand for channel modeling. This paper proposes a path loss prediction method based on spatial propagation environment characteristics with a combined application of convolutional neural network and deep neural network. Especially, the latest empirical path loss model is added in the proposed method as prior information for predicting path loss. The accuracy and efficiency of the proposed path loss prediction model are verified in this work with its application to ray tracing simulation examples that combine different propagation environment characteristics, transmitter (Tx) and receiver (Rx) coordinates, Tx-Rx distances, and the potential of this method for channel prediction in different urban communication scenarios is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Massively parallel Implementation of Multilevel Fast Multipole Algorithm on Sunway TaihuLight
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: We present in this paper a massively parallel approach of the multilevel fast multipole algorithm (PMLFMA) on homegrown Sunway TaihuLight supercomputer with SW26010 heterogeneous many-core processors, noted as (SW-PMLFMA), for 3-D electromagnetic scattering problems. In the proposed parallel implementation, the multilevel fast multipole algorithm (MLFMA) octree is first partitioned among management processing elements (MPEs) of SW26010 processors following the ternary partitioning scheme using the message passing interface (MPI). Then the computationally intensive parts of the PMLFMA on each MPI process, matrix filling, aggregation and disaggregation, etc., are accelerated by using all the 64 computing processing elements (CPEs) in the same core group of the MPE via the Athread programming model. Different parallelization strategies are designed for many-core accelerators to ensures a high computational throughput. Numerical results are included to demonstrate the efficiency and versatility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Broadband Circularly Polarized Antenna Based on ISGW and Polarization Conversion Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a broadband circularly polarized antenna fed by an integrated substrate gap waveguide (ISGW) and loaded with a polarization conversion metasurface (PCM) is proposed. The antenna mainly consists of two parts: a line polarized source antenna and a line polarization to circular polarization conversion metasurface(LP-to-CP PCM). The source antenna with ISGW feed can ensure the transmission of quasi-TEM modes and reduce the energy leakage. The radiation patch adopts a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3\times 3$</tex> metasurface structure, which can further increase the antenna bandwidth. Finally, the LP-to-CP PCM is designed and loaded onto the source antenna to realize the circular polarization radiation of the antenna. The simulation results show that the antenna can achieve 30.6% (24.6 GHz ∼33.5 GHz) impedance bandwidth and 15.0% (26.5 GHz ∼30.7 GHz) 3dB axial ratio bandwidth, which has potential applications in modern wireless communication systems.

articleTitle: Design of a Dual-Polarized Reconfigurable Reflectarray with Beam-Scanning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A novel dual-polarized reconfigurable reflectarray is proposed, in which four asymmetric cross-shaped patch elements are connected to the middle square patch element via PIN diodes to achieve independent horizontal and vertical polarization control. The simulated results show that the proposed unit cell has good performance in all four phase states, and the average insertion loss at 5.5 GHz is about 1.5 dB. A 10×10 reconfigurable reflectarray is designed and simulated, and the results show that the array can achieve a beam scan range of ±60°.

articleTitle: An VIE-PEEC Method for Circuit Parameters Extraction from Complex Packaging Structures
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a partial element equivalent circuit (PEEC) model based on SWG basis function is proposed for electromagnetic simulation of conductor-dielectric composite Alternating Current(AC) circuits. This method discretizes structures of interest through tetrahedral elements for geometric modeling. Then, the quasi-static moment method (MoM) solution of the volume electric field integral equation (EFIE) is derived, and the equivalent RLC circuit network is obtained by the PEEC method. Finally, import the network into the PARDISO for calculation. A numerical example is given to prove the accuracy and efficiency of the method.

articleTitle: S-parameter Measurement of Differential Log-periodic Antennas for SKA Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: For Square Kilometer Array (SKA) low-frequency aperture array, differentially-fed log-periodic antenna with all-metal structure is employed. In this paper, the reflection coefficient of differentially-fed log-periodic antennas with an additional metal measuring tool (MMT) is investigated. Specially, the measurement principle of the log-periodic antennas is analyzed by scattering matrix derivation. Based on the SKA log-periodic antenna (SKALA) elements, the structural influences of the MMT on antenna performance are numerically analyzed. Finally, the reliability and accuracy of the proposed measurement method is experimentally validated.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Modeling of Numerical Green's Function for Moving Scatterers Using Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents an electromagnetic modeling method for moving scatterers using artificial neural networks (ANN) in two dimensions. Using the quasi-static approximation method, each time point of a moving object is treated as static, and the NGF is predicted by the ANN for each time point. The training method of ANN is to sample the relationship between the field and source of the moving scatterer at various locations within a finite region as a dataset, and the trained network model can represent the NGF of the moving scatterer at any location. To verify the method, the NGF of a moving scatterer in two-dimensional is obtained by ANNs, and relative errors of the ANN-predicted NGF can reach less than 5%. The electric field obtained based on the ANN-predicted NGF is also shown.

articleTitle: Massively Parallel DGTD with Alternate-Buffer Remote Memory Access Method Based on the New Generation Sunway Supercomputer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a massively parallelism with the alternate-buffer remote memory access (RMA) method for the discontinuous Galerkin time domain method based on the new generation Sunway supercomputer is proposed. The alternate-buffer parallelism is used to reduce the communication between cores groups. The local memory of slave cores is devided into two parts to enable simultaneous calculation and communication with RMA. Compared with the parallelism without RMA and alternate-buffer, the proposed method has higher efficiency and achieves parallelism with one million cores on the new generation Sunway supercomputer.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-Layer Filtering Butler-Like Matrix with Flexible Phase Differences
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A compact topology for the filtering integrated <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$4\times 4$</tex> Butler-like matrix (BLM) with flexible beam steering has been proposed. This structure is constructed on three-layer circuits, with no crossover owing to the path distribution. A generalized coupling networks, consisting of two power dividers, two phase shifting units, and two shunt single-pole-double-throw (SPDT) switches, has been introduced to construct the BLM. Theoretical design equations for Butler-like matrices versus phase differences and intervals have been delivered with beam orthogonality.

articleTitle: A New Method for Out-of-Band Electromagnetic Interference Suppression of L-DACS1
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: L-band digital aeronautical communication system type 1 (L-DACS1) using orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) technology is a new multi-carrier communication system, deployed between distance measurement equipment (DME) channel gaps. Therefore, DME is its main source of interference, which is required for L-DACSl to have excellent spectral shaping performance in the frequency domain for suppressing out-of-band (OOB) emissions. In this paper, with the excellent performance of filter bank multicarrier (FBMC) in OOB suppression, we described the technical characteristics of OFDM and FBMC and analyzed the influence of DME on the out-of-band suppression and communication quality of the system when it is used as an interference source. FBMC technology has obvious advantages over OFDM in terms of OOB electromagnetic interference suppression and communication quality.

articleTitle: A Low Sidelobe Level Along Direction of Propagation 4-Order OAM Beam Generated by Hexagonal Reflective Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: As the potential of the OAM beam on wireless communication area was discovered by engineers, more and more attentions have been drawn into the OAM beam generating area. Metasurface as a two-dimensional resonant structure has become a popular method to generate the OAM beam efficiently. However, when the topologic number of the OAM beam comes to 4, the OAM beam generated by the metasurface has a high sidelobe level (SLL) appeared at the direction of propagation which will affect the distribution of the near-field and purity. In this paper, the reason why there is a large sidelobe at the propagation direction is analyzed through analysis method of array antenna. And then, based on the analysis, a hexagonal reflective meta-atom is designed and simulated. The designed meta-atom works at 10GHz and has a 2GHz bandwidth. And simulation results show that the phase range of the meta-atom manipulation can cover 0 to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2\pi$</tex>. Finally, a reflective metasurface combined by the hexagonal meta-atom is designed and simulated. And the simulation results show that the sidelobe level along the propagation direction of a 4-order OAM beam generated by a hexagonal metasurface is 20dB lower than that of a quadrilateral metasurface.

articleTitle: A Simple Design of Wideband Filtering Square Patch Antenna Based on Triple Modes via Loading of Slots
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a simple design of the wideband filtering antenna based on the square patch resonator via slit-loading. By properly incorporating two pairs of slots along both radiation edges of the square patch resonator, two additional resonant modes are produced around the conventional TM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf> mode. Moreover, these two modes both perform inverse electric field at two sides of the etched slot, which provide the potential for creation of radiation nulls. In this context, by taking fully utilization of these two new modes together with the TM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10,</inf>a wideband filtering antenna with three resonances and two radiation nulls is constructed. The simulated results indicate that the proposed antenna is operating from 3.34 to 3.66 GHz with a factional bandwidth of 9.14%. Besides, two zeros exist in the boresight gain frequency response at 3.29 and 3.75 GHz, leading to the high frequency selectivity in both passband edges.

articleTitle: A Novel FSS for 5G Applications with Low in-Band Insertion Loss
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A novel frequency selective surface structure (FSSs) for 5G applications with low in-band insertion loss (IL) has been presented. To improve the performance of the FSS especially in low in-band insertion loss, a multi-layer FSS structure is adopted to form a 2nd-order filter full-wave simulation results demonstrate that the proposed FSS has a wide-band response and very low in-band insertion loss under a large variety of the incident angles. 0 to 60 degrees, the maximum of average in-band insertion loss is only −0.78dB/GHz in TE and TM polarization These results demonstrate that the proposed FSS is a good candidate for 5G applications.

articleTitle: Analysis of Electromagnetic and Temperature Characteristics of Multi-Winding and High-Frequency Power Transformers
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: With the rapid development of power electronics technology, power equipment is moving towards high power density and miniaturization. Therefore, in order to solve the problems of large volume and high losses in traditional transformers, the application of power electronics technology to power transformers and the research and development of high-frequency transformers have become a hot direction in the power industry. This article constructs a 10kHz/50kW four-winding transformer with nanocrystalline core and litz wire winding. Accurately calculated the electromagnetic loss characteristics of high-frequency transformers under no-load test. And through electromagnetic temperature field coupling calculation method, Calculate the temperature distribution of high-frequency transformer under natural convection. Then analyze the hot spot temperature.

articleTitle: Design of SIW and HMSIW Miniaturized Filter Based on DGS
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In order to reduce the circuit area and improve device performance, this article designs a bandpass filter based on the SIW structure for the low-frequency band used in 5G communication, operating between 4.03GHz and 5.83GHz. The conical microstrip conversion structure is selected as the filter's input and output terminals, and a traditional dumbbell shape DGS unit with bandstop characteristics is etched on a grounded metal plate below the input and output terminals of the SIW to achieve miniaturization design of the filter. The simulation results show that the filter has good transmission characteristics and out of band suppression ability, and the return loss is better than 10dB. Afterwards, the DGS structure was loaded onto HMSIW. After HFSS simulation, the results showed that the broadband HMSIW filter had better return loss than 13dB in the 4.15~6.35 GHz frequency band, and its volume was only half that of traditional SIW filters. Therefore, it can better achieve the miniaturization design of the filter.

articleTitle: A Vector Fitting Enhanced GSTC-FDTD Method for Broadband Analysis of Dispersive Metasurfaces
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Over the past ten years, metasurfaces are a research focus in electromagnetics field, they offer possibilities to manipulate electromagnetic waves in unimaginable ways a decade ago. Here an enhanced finite-difference time-domain method with generalized sheet transition conditions is proposed for simulation of dispersive metasurface. Compared to the previous methods, the susceptibility extracting process is optimized, which makes it more accurate in broadband analysis. An example is presented to validate this enhanced method.

articleTitle: A Novel Hybrid Algorithm Based on FDTD Method and US-FDTD Method for Drude Media
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this article, a hybrid algorithm based on traditional finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method and unconditionally stable finite-difference time-domain method (US-FDTD) is proposed to simulate the Drude media with fine structures. In this algorithm, the calculation domain is divided into the coarse-grid region and the fine-grid region. In fine-grid region, the US-FDTD method overcoming the Courant Stability condition is applied; meanwhile, the traditional FDTD method is used to calculate the field in the coarse-grid region. The maximum time step size of this hybrid algorithm is the same as that of the traditional FDTD method which is related with the coarse grids in the coarse-grid region. The numerical example validates that the proposed hybrid algorithm can significantly improve the computational efficiency without sacrificing accuracy.

articleTitle: Modeling of Spectral Properties and Photocurrent of GaAs Cell with Rough Surface
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Due to the space irradiation, the protecting layer of GaAs cell would be eroded to be the rough surface, which leads to the reduction of absorption of photons and photoelectric conversion. This paper is focused on the simulation of spectral properties and photocurrent of GaAs cell, whose protecting layer is eroded to be the rough surface. The spectral properties of GaAs cell with rough surface are calculated with FDTD method and the photocurrent is simulated by solving Poisson's equation, continuity equation and drift-diffusion equation. The effects geometry parameters of rough surface on the spectral absorption and photoelectric conversion are discussed. The investigation on the photoelectric conversion performance of GaAs cell with rough surface could provide theory guidance for the solar cell design of satellite.

articleTitle: VHF Propagation Modelling in Forest Environment Using Parabolic Equation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The parabolic equation method is used to simulate the radio wave propagation in forest environment. The random distribution model of forest is established by Monte Carlo method, and the electric field distribution in forest environment is analyzed. The path loss distributions are observed by changing the density of tree distribution. A forest model with different densities is constructed by Monte Carlo method, and the path propagation loss of VHF band is simulated.

articleTitle: An Ultra-Wideband Double-Layer Microwave Metalens with Reverse Dispersion Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Microwave meta-lenses (or metasurface lenses) provide an exciting platform to develop a series of novel devices and systems such as transmit array antennas, flat retro-reflectors and compact imagers, etc. Up to now, to design an ultra-broadband plasmonic metalens with excellent focusing performances (such as high focusing efficiency or large numerical aperture) is still a great challenge especially in low frequency microwave regime. In this paper, an ultra-thin and ultra-broadband microwave metalens with a working bandwidth ranging from 13 to 18GHz is designed and its focusing performances are studied, presented and analyzed by a full-wave simulation studio (the relative bandwidth is 33.3% according to simulations, thickness is only 0.1λO, λO is the wavelength of 13GHz). Numerical simulations indicate that the focal length of the double-layer microwave metalens increases linearly along with increased working frequency which demonstrates a reverse dispersion property. High focusing efficiency range from 20%- 60°/ (the average value is above 40%) in the entire working bandwidth is achieved both with a high numerical aperture of 0.7 on average (NA=0.7). The presented studies can be beneficial to the development of broadband microwave metalenses with high- performance focusing and are promising for some applications in metalens-based microwave devices.

articleTitle: Fast Analysis of Array Structure Using Reduced Basis Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In order to quickly and accurately calculate the electromagnetic wideband characteristics of the array structure, this paper combines the reduced basis method (RBM) with the tangential equivalent principle algorithm (T-EPA). T -EPA is applied to solve the integral equation of the array structure, which transfers the problem on the target to the equivalence surface, thus reducing the total number of unknowns of the array and calculating the RCS of the array structure quickly, but it cannot perform the wideband processing. The RBM can accelerate the frequency sweep, including offline and online processes. The offline process constructs the reduced basis set by solving the solution vector corresponding to the parameter set, reduces the dimensionality of the impedance matrix, and speeds up the iterative solution of the linear system of equations in the online process. The numerical result shows that the computation time and memory are greatly reduced.

articleTitle: Transient Electro-thermal and Bandgap Narrowing Analysis of the bipolar transistor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Given the bandgap narrowing (BGN) effect caused by heavy doping of the bipolar transistor and the self-heating effect (SHE) in the practical work environment, a transient electro-thermal and bandgap narrowing model is proposed in this paper, which is based on the Slotboom model and the modification of the drift-diffusion equation based on semiconductor equations and the heat conduction equation. The transient characteristics of the bipolar transistor in amplification mode are simulated using the differential method, and the results show that the terminal current of the bipolar transistor decreases after considering the SHE and the BGN effect. The model developed and the results obtained in this work can provide some reference significance for the optimization of the amplification characteristics of the bipolar transistor.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Reflected Field of PEC Plate Coated with Biaxial Anisotropic Materials
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The spectral domain method (SDM) and saddle point technique (SPT) are used to analyze the reflection field of a PEC plate coated with biaxial anisotropic materials. Firstly, the electromagnetic parameter tensors are substituted into Maxwell's equations. According to the wave equation, the corresponding electromagnetic plane wave spectrum form is deduced. Then the boundary conditions of the top layer and the bottom layer in the spectral domain are introduced to solve the spectral domain scattering field of the coated plate. Finally, employing the SPT, the asymptotic solution of the electromagnetic scattering of the infinitely large PEC plate coated with the electromagnetically anisotropic medium body in the airspace is obtained. The calculation example and analysis in this paper illustrate the effectiveness of the method and the rationality of the received reflection field.

articleTitle: One-Dimensional Finite Element Method for Inhomogeneous Electrostatic Potential and Field
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a one-dimensional (1-D) finite element method (FEM) with fast construction of scalar basis functions and high solution accuracy in solving the electrostatic problems. Adopting the coordinate mapping to capture the basis function, the FEM can be implemented by the Gaussian integration. Compared with analytical solution, the computational errors from the 1-D FEM numerical solution will be less than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−10</sup> once the computational boundary is given. As the computational grid is encrypted, the numerical accuracy can be well enhanced to satisfy the current industrial environment.

articleTitle: Design Methodology of Resonant H-field Probe with a High Bandwidth in Near-Field Measurements
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Resonant near-field probes can be used for localization and characterization of noise sources in electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) applications. However, the usability of a resonant probe is limited by its narrow bandwidth. This article presents a design and the corresponding optimization flow which improves the bandwidth of a resonant H-field probe by adapting the impedance variation ratio of the transmission line balun. Compared to the traditional design, the proposed one achieves triple bandwidth with only 2.7 dB sensitivity loss. The improved design enables a more efficient scanning in real applications.

articleTitle: Design of a Miniaturized, Low Profile, Broadband Metasurface Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a miniaturized, low-profile wideband metasurface antenna is proposed. The antenna consists of a uniformly arranged hexagonal metasurface, a Y-shaped antenna, a ground plane, and a microstrip line. The microstrip line feeds energy to the antenna through a gap on the ground plane, and the antenna radiates energy to the metasurface. Through the feed gap, different resonant modes are excited at the same time, so that the antenna presents the performance of broadband, and low profile is achieved by optimizing the structure of the metasurface and antenna. The simulation results show that the impedance bandwidth of the antenna is 4.45-6.73GHz (40.8<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>), the total size is 0.6λ*0.6λ*0.065λ (where λ is the free space wavelength at the center operating frequency), the realized gain can reach 7.2dBi, the total efficiency is more than 88%, and the linear polarization characteristics are good in the operating band.

articleTitle: Ground Radar Target Classification Algorithm Based on Enhanced-Squeeze-and-Excitation-Multiscale Wide Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: We propose a ground radar target classification algorithm based on the ESE-MWRN. The attention mechanism is introduced to improve the classification performance of the Multiscale Wide Residual Network (MWRN). The algorithm has good classification performance for human, vehicle, and UAV samples, with an overall classification rate as high as 98%.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of Maritime Target Detection Using Passive Bistatic Radar
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A passive bistatic radar system for the detection of moving targets at sea is designed in this paper. Through the continuous acquisition of non-cooperative radar direct wave and echo data, pulse compression, incoherent integration, MTI moving target processing, adaptive constant false alarm detection, and finally realize the detection of maritime targets. In this paper, the process of the proposed method is explained in detail, and then the field experiment is carried out. The experiment obtained clearly range-azimuth display image and PPI display image. Preliminary results of field experiments show that the system can successfully detect targets at sea.

articleTitle: A Novel Model for Sea Surface Loss Transport in Complex Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The current prediction model for sea surface signal transmission is relatively simple to establish and has significant errors compared to the actual situation. This article establishes a novel sea transmission model based on the dual-path model and the modified Longley-Rice model, and applies the two models to different transmission distances. The relationship between the received signal power of ocean buoy antenna and distance was simulated by taking into account the absorption of water vapor on the sea surface, the influence of waves, and sea winds. The simulation results show that this model can be used to analyze the effects of complex sea surface environments and has some significance for sea surface communication.

articleTitle: Compact Genetic Algorithm Based on Roulette Selection Operator for Synthesizing thinned Arrays
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In thinned array synthesis, it is easy to fall into local optimum using non-global optimization strategies due to the lack of global search capability. On the other hand, synthesis using stochastic optimization algorithms that facilitate global search, such as genetic algorithms, can easily fail in large arrays with thousands of elements. This paper proposes an optimization algorithm based on the compact genetic algorithm (cGA) to realize robust global search of thinned array synthesis that is not limited by the array size. Compared with cGA, the proposed algorithm reduces the computational effort by 17.9%/ 73.8% /87.4%, respectively, in optimizing fully populated arrays of 100/500/ 1000 elements. Multiple results show that the global search ability of the proposed algorithm is better than that of the stochastic optimization algorithms.

articleTitle: Simulation of radial coaxial dielectric barrier discharge plasma reactor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a two-dimensional fluid model of radial coaxial packed-bed dielectric barrier discharge (DBD) is developed to investigate the effects of different dielectric constant packed beads and different voltages on plasma behavior in a DBD reactor. The reduction in discharge space due to the addition of packing beads significantly contributes to the generation of plasma discharge. The discharge pattern in packed bed DBD reactors is altered, manifesting itself as dispersion and local filamentary discharges. Raising the voltage or raising the dielectric constant of the packing beads can promote the generation of plasma discharges. This study provides a reference for a more specific understanding of plasma behavior in DBD reactors.

articleTitle: Analysis of Low-Frequency Wave Propagation in the Ground-Ionosphere Waveguide Transition Region with Parallel DGTD
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Aiming at the propagation of low-frequency electromagnetic waves in the ground-ionosphere waveguide containing the diurnal transition region, this paper establishes an ideal propagation model, calculates the wave transmission model in the TM wave case in the ground-ionosphere waveguide using the discontinuous Galerkin time domain (DGTD) method. In addition, the effect of the change of the transceiver position on the transmission is analyzed. To address the problems of large electromagnetic computation and low computational efficiency, this paper investigates the OpenMP acceleration algorithm of DGTD, and takes the DGTD simulation calculation of electromagnetic wave propagation in the ground-ionosphere waveguide transition region as an example to realize the multi-threaded parallelization of cell iteration. The results of the algorithm show that the parallel technique used in this paper can effectively improve the computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Scattering characteristics of a polyhedral Van Atta backtracking array
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In order to achieve effective interference with multi-directional early warning radar and cover our combat targets in the process of implementing airborne high-value combat target surprise defense, a Van Atta retracing array based on 14-sided Archimedes polyhedral configuration is proposed, and a Van Atta array unit with positive hexagonal distribution is designed according to the polyhedral configuration. The research results show that this scattering polyhedron has a compact structure with the advantage of omnidirectional scattering, and has good potential for application in scenarios requiring strong omnidirectional retrieval capability.

articleTitle: A Four-Element mmWave MIMO Antenna Array for 5G Handheld Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A novel Multiple Input Multiple Output (MIMO) antenna for 5G mmWave communication is presented. The proposed antenna array consists of four antenna elements, and each element is based on the combination of substrate integrated cavity and monopole antenna. Antenna elements are placed at the top of the bakelite substrate. Simulation results show that the antenna array can achieve greater than 18 dB isolation and −10dB impedance bandwidth of 3.55 GHz (24.65-28.20 GHz). Moreover, the antenna array is highly compact and can be suitable for the 5G handheld devices.

articleTitle: EM Scattering Prediction of Complex Targets by SBR and QEM-based Mesh Reduction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, the mesh reduction method based on QEM is combined with Shooting and Bouncing Ray (SBR) algorithm to improve the electromagnetic (EM) scattering computational efficiency of electrically large complex targets. On the premise of not too much loss of model accuracy, the number of triangular facets can be reduced as far as possible with the use of QEM-based mesh reduction technique. On this basis, the SBR method is utilized to calculate the EM scattering of a single aircraft and a three-aircraft formation before and after mesh reduction. Meanwhile, the runtime for a single aircraft and a three-aircraft formation before and after mesh reduction is compared. A good speedup is achieved.

articleTitle: Design of the Radiation-type Circularly-Polarized Programmable Metasurface Unit
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This work presents a design of the radiation-type circularly-polarized programmable metasurface unit. The metasurface unit is excited by a coupled microstrip probe, and two PIN diodes are integrated on the unit radiation patch, and the two diodes are placed in an antisymmetric manner. By controlling the bias voltage of the PIN diode, the radiation beam of the antenna unit can present two different phases of 0° and 180°, corresponding to the digital code “0” and “1”. When the two diodes are in different states, the radiation beam of metasurface unit presents a phase difference of 180° in a certain range, which can realize the dynamic regulation of electromagnetic radiation characteristics.

articleTitle: An Improved Hybrid Method for Solving Large-Scale Electromagnetic Problems with Local Inhomogeneous Structures
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: An iterative FEBI-PO hybrid method has been proposed to deal with the large-scale problem having local inhomogeneous structures. In this paper, the PEC part of exterior surface of inhomogeneous structure is also taken as PO region, which makes the PO region as large as possible. Moreover, in the iterative process, only the problem with the variables on the dielectric boundary of local complex inhomogeneous structure and the problem with variables in PO region need to be solved alternately, which avoids solving the whole problem in FEBI region repeatedly. In addition, several numerical results are discussed to illuminate the efficiency of the improved scheme.

articleTitle: Simulation of Electromagnetic Pulse Coupling Effect with a Parallel Time-Domain FEM Solver
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The electromagnetic pulse (EMP) coupling effect is an important research area in electromagnetic compatibility and electromagnetic interference. Numerical simulation plays an important role in the study of the pulse coupling effect. To achieve an efficient and effective simulation, a parallel solver based on time-domain finite element method (TD-FEM) is proposed, which is developed based on JAUMIN framework. This parallel TD-FEM solver is employed to simulate the effects of an EMP coupling to a printed circuit board at work.

articleTitle: Compact Multiband Coupled-Fed Antenna Design For Metal Rim Handset
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A compact antenna for the LTE/WWAN operation is proposed in this paper, which is designed for unbroken full-metal rim mobile handset. The antenna is composed of two L-shaped slots on the ground and coupling microstrip feed line placed on the FR4 substrate. The two loops generate multiple nearby resonant modes to expand the antenna bandwidth. The final simulation results show that the proposed antenna operates in the GSM1800/GSM1900/ DCS/PCS UMTS 2100/LTE 2300 bands.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Novel Miniaturized Ultra-Thin Wide-Band Metamaterial Absorber
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The volume of existing metamaterial absorber (MMA) is not small enough to be applied in miniaturized devices such as chip level. To solve this problem, a miniaturized ultrathin wide-band MMA is proposed in this paper. The thickness of proposed MMA is 1.1mm with a absorption rate of 99.6% at 19.7GHz. This paper also analyzes the influence of parameters of the proposed MMA on the absorption performance and proves that it has a certain tunability of the absorption band. By comparing with other works, the MMA proposed in this paper realizes the miniaturization of the structure while ensuring ultra-wideband. This benefit offers a novel approach to address the problem of difficult loading electromagnetic shielding structures in miniaturized chip designs.

articleTitle: Design of Control Circuit for Active Metasurface Based on Varactor Diode
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A control circuit for active metasurface based on varactor diode is designed in this paper. By varying the reverse bias voltage on the varactor diode, the designed circuit can regulate the additional phase of the active meta-atoms. The circuit adopts a form of one master and multiple slaves, which can simultaneously control the bias voltage of 960 meta-atoms. Each slave can control up to 64 channels. The control accuracy is 0.04V. The power consumption of a single slave is 160mW. Though experiment verification, the circuit has a good effect in controlling the beam deflection of the metasurface and generating OAM beams.

articleTitle: MLFMA Accelerated Characteristic Mode Analysis of Lossy Inhomogeneous Material
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The multilevel fast multipole algorithm (MLFMA) is adopted to accelerate the characteristic mode analysis of lossy inhomogeneous material. The method of moment is combined with a mixed basis function scheme to obtain the discretized eigenvalue equation. The impedance matrix achieved by the proposed discretizing scheme is numerically symmetric and hence ensures an orthogonal mode solution. Analysis of a composite dielectric resonator antenna is presented for validation. The computational consumption is greatly reduced because of the employment of MLFMA.

articleTitle: A High Performance Ultra-Wideband Energy Selective Surface
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, by analyzing two traditional ESS and using the equivalent circuit model (ECM), a high-performance wideband energy selective surface (ESS) is proposed. The structure consists of two layers of printed arrow-shaped metal-dielectric substrates separated by air. The simulation results show that the proposed ESS provides more than 30dB shielding for high-power signals and an insertion loss lower than 1 dB for low-power signals in a wide frequency band of 0.5-4GHz.

articleTitle: Inverse Piezoelectric Effect in a GaN HEMT Under HPM Pulses
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This work aims to study the inverse piezoelectric effect of gallium nitride (GaN) high-electron mobility transistors (HEMTs) under high-power microwave (HPM) pulses where sensitive semiconductor devices are often disturbed or even damaged by intentional electromagnetic interference (IEMI). A series of GaN HEMT-based power amplifiers are designed and measured. In the analysis, the elastic energy density of AlGaN under different DC conditions and pulse powers are calculated and compared with the critical value of AlGaN material itself. TCAD simulation support the whole analysis.

articleTitle: Design of Novel Single Band-Stop Frequency Selective Surface Suitable for N258-band
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper proposes a single band-stop frequency selective surface (FSS) designed for operation in the extended frequency band of 5G. The proposed FSS is has dimensions of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3\mathrm{m}\mathrm{m}\times 3\mathrm{m}\mathrm{m} (0.26\lambda\times 0.26\lambda)$</tex> and a thickness of 0.4 mm, demonstrating miniaturization characteristics. The unit cell structure is simulated using electromagnetic simulation software CST, and the parameters of the equivalent circuit are calculated simultaneously. CST electromagnetic simulation results show that the structure exhibits stability for oblique incident angles ranging from 0 to 80 degrees and is insensitive to polarization. The maximum frequency deviation in TE and TM modes at different angles is only 0.3%. The attenuation depth reaches -50dB at the resonance frequency. This structure has a wide range of potential applications, such as designing shielding covers for the 5G expansion frequency band known as N258.

articleTitle: Channel Allocation Optimization of UAV Based on Intelligent Ray Tracing in Urban Outdoor Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The paper studies that in the dense urban outdoor environment Unmanned Aerial Vehicle(UAV) swarms establish the deterministic channel model to optimize their performance for ground communication. Facing the complex electromagnetic environment in the city, this paper uses the intelligent ray tracing (IRT) to model the wireless channel between the hovering UA V and the ground receiving terminal. Then we use game theory (local congestion game) approach to solve the global optimization problem of channel allocation for UAV swarm. Finally, simulation results show that the proposed algorithm reduces the interference level of the whole network and improves the quality of communication services. And the obtained results are more precise than those of statistical models.

articleTitle: Wideband Low-Loss Rectangular-to-Circular Coaxial Transition Within DC-80 GHz
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This conference presents a rectangular-to-circular coaxial transition with low-loss property and compact structure. The required impedance matching is achieved by three cylinders with different sizes. Moreover, three chamfered structures are analyzed to compensate for the parasitic capacitance. The simulated results show that the designed transition structure has a return loss better than 42 dB from DC to 80 GHz and insertion loss better than 0.028 dB below 80 GHz. The characteristic impedance of the rectangular to circular coaxial transition is well matched to 50 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\Omega$</tex>, facilitating for the measurement applications of some components.

articleTitle: Coherent Accumulation Method for Short-Range High-Velocity Target Based on PRF Agile Radar
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In pulse repetition frequency (PRF) agile radar systems, when the target has high velocity or the coherent processing time is too long, the random PRF variations cause the echo pulse to appear to shift across the range unit during coherent accumulation, making it impossible to obtain accurate velocity and range information through coherent accumulation. To address this issue, this paper proposes the utilization of the Keystone transform to correct the range migration caused by random variations in the PRF. Additionally, the non-uniform fast Fourier transform (NUFFT) is applied along the slow-time dimension, enabling accurate acquisition of target velocity and range information through coherent accumulation. Furthermore, in a multi-target scenario, the proposed method enables accurate detection of each target. Simulation test results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in correcting range migration during coherent accumulation in PRF agile radar, thereby accurately obtaining velocity and range information for each target in the multi-target scenario. Moreover, the computational complexity is reduced by utilizing the Chirp-z algorithm, which requires less computational resources, for implementing the Keystone transform.

articleTitle: Research on Ionospheric F Layer Characteristics During the 24th Solar Cycle at Kunming
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The ionosphere, which is ionized by solar and cosmic radiation, is a part of the atmosphere that extends approximately 60 to 1000km from the surface. As an important component of the Earth's space environment, variations in the ionosphere have a significant impact on electronic information systems, potentially leading to disruptions in shortwave communications and increased errors in satellite navigation systems. Kunming is located on the southeast side of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau with a large altitude gradient. Meanwhile, it is also situated in the north peak region of the equatorial ionization anomaly (EIA), resulting in complex and unique characteristics of ionospheric variation in the Kunming region. In this paper, we investigate the diurnal, seasonal, and solar cycle variations of the critical frequency and the bottom height of the F layer by utilizing the observation data of the 24th solar activity cycle from Kunming ionosonde station. The results provide significant insights into researching ionospheric variations and upper-lower atmospheric coupling mechanisms.

articleTitle: Breakdown Thresholds Prediction for Microwave Devices with Pulsed Excitation and Temperature Effects
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents an accurate and efficient method to analyze the air breakdown of microwave devices under high-power microwave. The spectral element time-domain(SETD) method has employed to analyze the breakdown threshold in the cases of different pulsed excitations and ambient temperatures. The numerical results show that the microwave breakdown threshold for pulsed excitation is larger than that for continuous waves at the same pressure, and the change in temperature leads to a shift in the Paschen curve. In addition, the proposed method is computationally more efficient than SPARK3D with the same accuracy.

articleTitle: A Simplified Method of Connection Boundary for the HIE-FDTD Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The Hybrid-implicit-explicit finite difference time domain method (HIE-FDTD) is a weakly conditionally stable technique that is well-suited for the computation of thin structures in a single direction. However, the implicit iteration introduces complexities when employing the connection boundary–total field/scatter field (TF/SF)–approach for introducing plane waves. The conventional approach necessitates solving the auxiliary one-dimensional FDTD using an implicit formulation, which leads to increased complexity and computational resource requirements. To address these challenges, this paper presents a straightforward and efficient method that avoids the use of an implicit formulation while achieving excellent agreement with FDTD results.

articleTitle: A Crossed S-shaped Frequency Selective Surface for Electromagnetic Wave Absorption With Excellent Angular Stability
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a frequency selective surface (FSS) for electromagnetic wave absorption with excellent angular stability is proposed. It is suitable for stealth applications with reflection characteristics at resonant frequency points. The FSS is attached to an FR-4 substrate which is backed with a conductive layer at the bottom. The unit cell structure consists of two S-shaped bars and four circles, which enables miniaturization of the absorber. The reflection characteristics of the surface element are analyzed by the full wave simulation. Analysis of transverse electric (TE) and transverse magnetic (TM) polarization modes and oblique incidence angle responses demonstrate that the proposed FSS ensures angle independence. The resonant mechanism is analyzed and an equivalent circuit model (ECM) is built. Finally, an experiment in the anechoic chamber is conducted to validate the simulation results.

articleTitle: Multi-Scale Electromagnetic Simulation Through Parallel Adaptive Mesh Refinement FDTD Method with Symmetric Positive Semi-Definite Subgridding Scheme
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: FDTD method is a common approach for electromagnetic propagation, scattering and coupling simulation. Conventional FDTD with universal mesh requires numerous computations to represent solve problems with multi-scale structures. In this paper, adaptive mesh refinement (AMR) strategy is performed to reduce the calculations along with symmetric positive semi-definite subgridding scheme to guarantee stability. Numerical example of a missile seeker coupling simulation shows that the computation time decrease down to 2% while preserving excellent precision.

articleTitle: An Efficient Hybrid Method for Time Domain Analysis of Reverberation Chamber
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Three-dimension simulation of reverberation chamber (RC) is a reliable approach for RC designing, evaluating and optimizing. In this paper, an efficient hybrid method has been described for time domain analysis of the RC. This hybrid method is composed of finite-element time-domain (FETD) method, the domain decomposition (DD) algorithm and the matrix pencil method (MPM). Since the FETD method is well known for its flexibility in geometrical modeling, the stirrers and antenna contained in the reverberation chamber can be accurately simulated. Combined with DD algorithm, the memory usage is rescued. Moreover, the RC model can be divided into two types: one type is stirrers' subdomains which geometric model is changed; the other is constant subdomains which geometric model is not changed. Compared to conventional RC modeling method, only the stirrer subdomains need to be constructed model, formed matrix and LU factorized the coefficient matrix at each stirrers' rotated angle, the constant subdomains only need to do these operations at the first stirrers' rotated angle. Meanwhile, since the RC is a cavity which has high Q factor, the simulation can be accelerated by the MPM.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Method to Solve the Eigenvalues of Characteristic Modes Using PointNet
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents an artificial intelligent method that can be used to solve the eigenvalues of characteristic modes (CM) of a PEC target. This method uses PointNet neural network with point cloud as input and eigenvalues as output. The process of meshing and matrix generation in the traditional method is skipped, and the eigenvalues are directly calculated, thus accelerating the process of CM analysis. A dataset consisting of PEC quadrangular platforms is constructed. Numerical experiments demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed method. This method is useful in the field of antenna design and target scattering analysis.

articleTitle: Analysis on Influence of Flight Speed on Scattering Characteristics of RAM -CII Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The Finite Volume Time Domain (FVTD) method can be used to effectively fit complex shaped scatterer. This method can be better combined with the flow field and has high computational accuracy, which is suitable for the calculation of electromagnetic scattering characteristics of plasma coating. The electromagnetic simulation model of RAM-CII aircraft is established, and the correctness of the algorithm is verified. FVTD method is used to calculate and analyze the effect on changes in flight speed at the same altitude on the RAM-CII model with plasma sheath.

articleTitle: Inversion of 2D Permittivity Distribution with Iterative Data to Born Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this study, we propose an iterative data to Born method (IDTBM) for inverse scattering problems (ISPs), utilizing the reduced order model (ROM) of the wave operator. We prove that the approach can mitigate the nonlinearity and cycle-skipping of permittivity distribution inversion. The feasibility of the approach is validated by numerical examples, which exhibit its robust convergence performance and satisfactory inversion results.

articleTitle: Adaptive Mesh Refinement for Heat Transfer Problems in Electronic Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper proposes an efficient adaptive mesh refinement (AMR) algorithm for heat transfer problems in electronic devices. Such algorithm doesn't pay attention to the global error in our entire domain. Instead, a goal-oriented approach is introduced to estimate its influence on our specific metrics. In this vein, unnecessary refinement for non-contributed elements are eliminated. With the intention to elucidate this algorithm, a surface mount package is modeled to show its capability in convergence behaviors.

articleTitle: A Physics-Circuit Co-Electrothermal Simulation Approach for PHEMT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The behavior of the pseudomorphic high electron mobility transistor (PHEMT) module highly depends on the inner electric and temperature fields. At the same time, there is strong nonlinear coupling between these two physical quantities. In this paper, a transient co-simulation method based on PSPICE and COMSOL is introduced to deal with the systematic electrothermal simulation. The electrical-thermal coupling mechanism of PHEMT is briefly introduced first, and then the circuit model and solid heat transfer model are established in PSPICE and COMSOL respectively. Finally, a data exchange module for two simulation platforms is specially developed to implement the coupled simulation. Some simulation results are presented at the end.

articleTitle: A Model of Electromagnetic Wave Propagation in Evaporative Duct above on Rough Sea Surface
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a new model of electromagnetic wave propagation in the evaporation duct above on rough sea surface is proposed. Over the published results, the rough sea surface is usually regarded as a surface without undulations. Here, the rough sea surface with PM spectrum is simulated. And in this paper, the ray tracing method is applied to calculate the ray trajectory in evaporation duct. The pathloss of each ray was calculated based on the pathloss formula. By comparing with the results obtained from the model without undulations, the new model considering the rough sea surface can better simulate the real situation in the evaporation duct above the rough sea surface.

articleTitle: A Circular Polarized Endfire Leaky-Wave Antenna Based on Offset Double-Sided Parallel Strip Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a novel design for an endfire leaky-wave antenna with high gain and circular polarized (CP) radiation. By etching a series of slots and metal pins on the offset double-sided parallel strip lines, the slots and the edges of the strip line can provide two fields with a 90° phase difference for CP radiation. Meanwhile, the Hanson-Woodyard condition is also met to realize the endfire radiation. To verify our conclusion, an antenna prototype is designed and simulated, the results show that the endfire antenna provides a maximum gain of 12.2 dBi and the maximum radiation efficiency is 90%. Furthermore, CP radiation capability is also validated through the axial ratio.

articleTitle: A Compact Anti-Interference Pattern Reconfigurable Quasi-Yagi Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A quasi-Yagi antenna with pattern reconfigurable anti-interference feature is proposed in this paper. By controlling the PIN diodes located at the dividing boundary between the first- and third-order mode of the dipole, the effective electrical length is changed, which enables the dipole to work in different modes for pattern reconfiguration. The difference of the radiation patterns of the first- and third-order mode allows switching between two different scenarios subject to or not subject to interference for anti-interference. The proposed antenna is well-designed and carefully researched using simulation software. The simulation results show that the antenna has pattern reconfigurable anti-interference characteristics and is expected to be used for 5G wireless communication applications.

articleTitle: Integrated Design and Electromagnetic Calculation Based on Wide-Band End-Beam Antenna and Radome
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a conformal end-fire wide-band antenna and radome integrated structure with operating frequency of 2 GHz ∼ 18 GHz is designed and Calculated. The difference of typical characteristic between conformal antenna and radome is analyzed. The results show that the radome has little effect on the gain and VS WR of the antenna, and has a great effect on antenna pattern. Therefore, when designing conformal end-fire antenna and radome, it is important to consider the distortion of pattern.

articleTitle: Ray-Based Discontinuous Galerkin Method for Electromagnetic Wave Propagation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper introduces a ray-based discontinuous Galerkin (DG) method that has been successfully applied to solve the problem of vortex electromagnetic wave propagation. This method allows for a relative reduction in the number of grid points used for discretization in each wavelength compared to classical numerical methods, thereby decreasing the degree of freedom required. The performance of the in-house solver is evaluated through the simulation of a typical ship target. The result demonstrates that the proposed method possesses stability and efficiency.

articleTitle: A Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface for Broadband Achromatic Beam Deflection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Metasurfaces have excellent capabilities that can arbitrarily control the phase.,amplitude., and polarization of electromagnetic waves. However, traditional metasurfaces have inherent dispersion and lack of tunability, which seriously restrict their development and application. This paper proposes a reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) to effectively manipulate the wavefront in a broadband and achromatic manner. Because the dynamically tunable components can control the dispersion and the direction of the beam deflection, the broadband effect and flexible tunability of the metasurface can be achieved simultaneously. The relative bandwidth of the dynamic achromatic RIS can reach 14%, and a beam deflection range of 25° is achieved. The proposed approach possibly promotes the progress of RIS-aided wireless communications and RIS-based information transmission.

articleTitle: A Novel $H$-Band Rectangular TE10 to TE40 Mode Converter with Out-Phase Input Coupling Apertures
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A novel <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$H$</tex>-band (220–325 GHz) rectangular TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf> to TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">40</inf> mode converter with two out-phase input coupling apertures is presented in this paper. An E-plane T-junction power divider is introduced to provide two equal-amplitude and out-phase input signals to excite the overmoded waveguide. The theoretical analysis of the equivalent magnetic current sources for two input coupling apertures is adopted to study the basic mode converting structure. The methods to suppress the competing TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</inf> mode are presented and discussed. Simulation results having considered the conductor loss show that the mode converter obtains a 1 dB transmission bandwidth of 45.8 GHz, in which the reflection is lower than −13 dB and the maximum mode purity is up to 99.97%.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-Functional Frequency Selector Rasorber With Absorption and Transmission
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a multi-functional frequency selector rasorber(FSR) is designed. The structure consists of two modules, the first one being a lossy layer with resistors and the second one consisting of a polarization conversion module. The two modules are designed separately and finally combined together to achieve the function of integrated absorption and transmission. The FSR achieves <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\vert \mathrm{S}_{11}\vert \leq-8\ \text{dB}$</tex> in the full band from 2.1 to 12GHz at X-polarization and cross-polarization <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$> -3\text{dB}$</tex> at X-band. The absorbing band from 2.5 to 8.3 GHz is realized under y polarization. The unit size is only <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.21\lambda_{\mathrm{L}}\times 0.21\lambda_{\mathrm{L}}\times 0.079\lambda_{\mathrm{L}},\lambda_{\mathrm{L}}$</tex> is the low frequency wavelength, achieved low profile requirements.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of a Nearby Lightning-Magnetic Field Environment Simulator
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper designs and develops a nearby lightning-magnetic field simulator. The simulation result shows that the magnetic field distribution in the parallel double current loops structure is uniform; the magnetic field waveform characteristics are consistent with the injection current waveform. The magnetic field simulator can produce a pulsed magnetic field with a peak value of 869.27∼3267.45 A/m by adjusting the injection current level. The magnetic field change rate increases with the increase of the injection current level, and the maximum change rate can reach <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2.651\times 10^{9}\ \mathrm{A}/\mathrm{m}/\mathrm{s}$</tex>. Similar to the simulation results, under the same injection current level, the magnetic field intensity and waveform characteristics at different positions in the loops are basically the same, and the field distribution is good.

articleTitle: Direction Finding Rectenna Array Based on Amplitude Comparison Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a direction finding rectenna array system based on the amplitude comparison method. Compared to traditional methods, the proposed system eliminates the requirement for intricate down-conversion and signal processing. Furthermore, it enables the direct acquisition of the amplitude information of incoming signals, simplifying the process and enhancing efficiency. The overall direction finding error based on the proposed method is less than 5°, while effectively reducing system complexity and cost. Experimental results confirm the feasibility and performance of the proposed method. The system could find applications in navigation systems, wireless communications, radar systems, etc.

articleTitle: Design of Dual-Polarized Magneto-Electric Dipole Antenna with Improved Gain
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A new small size magneto-electric dipole antenna with high gain and dual-polarization is presented here. By bending the feeding probes, the connection on the patches is kept at the same level in order to ensure the consistency of two ports, and the introduction of metal back cavity effectively improves the gain of the antenna, hence the maximum gain can reach to about 10.49dBi, which is 0.42dBi higher than the structure without back cavity. Meanwhile, the size of the antenna is only <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf {0.82 \lambda_0 \times 0.82 \lambda_0 \times 0.13 \lambda_0}$</tex>.

articleTitle: 1-Bit Programmable Circularly Polarized Beam Scanning Array Based on PB Phase
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A low-profile 1-bit programmable circularly polarized (CP) beam scanning array based on PB phase is proposed in this paper. The current direction can be changed by regulating the PIN diodes to achieve 0° and 180° phase, i.e. 1-bit. Furthermore, the CP antenna can be rotated in-plane to obtain different initial PB phases. The initial PB phase of each array element is optimized by a genetic algorithm (GA), which effectively eliminates the 1-bit array grating lobe to achieve a single beam scan. The introduction of the PB phase simplifies the way in which the initial phase is fed through the phase shifter. This greatly simplifies the design complexity of the power division and improves the scalability of the array. Simulation results confirm that the proposed 1-bit CP array has no grating lobes and the side lobes are below -10 dB for beam scans of (θ, φ), where φ = [0°,45°, 90°, 135°] and θ = [0°, 15°, -15°, 30°, -30°, 45°, -45°].

articleTitle: Enhanced CBP ISAR Imaging Via CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Conventional imaging methods for maneuvering targets suffer from low resolution, poor noise rejection, sidelobes and grating lobes. To address the above problems, we propose a deep learning-based method for Inverse Synthetic Aperture Radar (ISAR) image enhancement based on Convolution Back Projection Algorithm (CBPA) imaging. The performance of the proposed method is evaluated with simulated data. And the results show that our proposed method demonstrates superior performance compared to the enhancement method relying solely on the coarse ISAR image input.

articleTitle: A Method for Modeling DC Potential Fields in Charged Lossy Dielectric Media
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Numerical modeling of the DC potential field for mise-a-la-masse (MALM) method in a lossy dielectric medium is of particular interest to geophysics researchers. In this paper, we propose a numerical technique for modeling DC potential fields in charged lossy dielectric media. A numerical solver of charged current transportation is firstly presented using finite different method, then the DC potential is integrated from all unit current element with Legendre function polynomial. A new formula of electrical resistivity calculation is also proposed for MALM surveying. This new technique is verified through comparisons with numerical cases and field surveys. The numerical results agree well with the water tank experiment measured data, variations in charged locations, electrical properties, and rotations. A realistic example of the application of this new method in the field of mineral exploration is presented. The basic problem formulation is quite general, but it is directly applicable in MALM surveying as a geophysical technique where the DC potential produced by charged lossy dielectric media is of interest.

articleTitle: Design of Wideband Microstrip Antenna Based on Characteristic Mode Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, by analyzing the characteristic mode of the rectangular patch, and the way of slotting and loading branches on the patch is used to broaden the bandwidth by more expected modes and resonant frequency points. The second desired mode is introduced by slotting, and a dual-band microstrip antenna is obtained. By loading branches at different positions, the bandwidths at different modes are widened respectively, and a common aperture antenna is obtained by combining. By loading two pairs of branches on the same patch, a microstrip antenna with 35% relative bandwidth is realized.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Arbitrary Backscattering Programmable Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: We propose a programmable metasurface based on deep learning to realize arbitrary backscattering radar cross section. This method encodes the metacell into binary values of “1”, “2”, “3,” and “4” respectively, using a 2-bit programmable digital matesurface unit that relies on a switch diode. Enable amplitude prediction across a broad angle range from -60 to 60 degrees. We successfully validate the effectiveness of this method through various experiments

articleTitle: A Cross-Coupling-Based Design of Filtering Power Divider
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Filters and power dividers, as important devices in RF transceivers, are usually designed independently and then connected together by 50 ohm transmission lines. The resulting matching network and cascade lines not only increase the system size, but also generate losses and thus reduce efficiency. In this paper, a fourth-order open-loop filter based on cross-coupling is designed, introducing two transmission zeros to optimize the filter performance and reduce the filter size, and finally cascading a wilkinson power divider to achieve power distribution. Simulation results show that the filtering power divider operates in the frequency band 4.75~5GHz, with return loss greater than 10dB, insertion loss less than 4.5dB and output port isolation greater than 18dB.

articleTitle: Electro-Thermal Coordination Simulation of Microwave Power Matching Load Structure with the FDTD Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Microwave power matching loads play an important role in impedance matching and system protection. Therefore, it is important to analyze the reliability of microwave power matching loads. In this paper, an accurate electro-thermal coupling method for TaN microwave power matching loads is proposed. The coupling format of transient Maxwell's equations and steady-state heat conduction equations is used for the multiscale characteristics of the response times of these two physical fields. And the numerical implementation based on the domain of the finite-difference time domain (FDTD) method is described in detail. Numerical examples show that the method has high accuracy compared with simulation and provides an effective tool for the design of highly reliable microwave power matching loads.

articleTitle: A Provably Stable FDTD Subgridding Method with Arbitrary Grid Ratio for Multisale Structures
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A stable finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) sub-gridding method is proposed to efficiently and accurately solve three-dimensional electromagnetic problems. The symmetric interpolation operators between coarse and subgridding meshes are carefully designed to confirm long-time stability. In addition, the proposed method supports arbitrary grid ratios and nested subgridding meshes. Results show that its stability can be guaranteed, and the accuracy and efficiency are improved.

articleTitle: A SAR Active Jamming Detection Method Based on Image Grayscale Features
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In response to the problem that the validation and evaluation of SAR active jamming effectiveness is more complicated and target detection of SAR image is seldom applied to active jamming, a method of SAR image active jamming detection based on image grayscale features is proposed in this paper. Herein, the principle and process of SAR image target detection algorithm processing, based on pulse coupled neural network are discussed. Through the simulation experiment, the active jamming region can be detected in the SAR jamming image.

articleTitle: Design of Curved FSS with A Fast Accurate Simulation Method based on Transmission Line Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A fast simulation method is proposed in this paper to effectively deal with the difficulty of calculating frequency selective surface (FSS) on curved surfaces. This method extracts the equivalent circuit parameter of the FSS unit based on transmission line theory and uses it for building equivalent models of the FSS structure. Numerical examples show that the proposed method can significantly improve the calculation efficiency without losing accuracy. Hence, the equivalent modeling method for FSS (EMMF) can greatly help to verify and optimize the performance design of curved FSS.

articleTitle: Analysis of Lightning Response Characteristics of Metamaterial Structures
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, the lightning response characteristics of one typical electrical connected metamaterial-cross grid structure. The results show that for the electrically connected metamaterials, direct grounding of the metal part can reduce the overall electric field intensity during lightning strike. Under the same type of lightning strike point-grounding point, changing the relative position of the grounding point and lightning strike point in the same direction has little effect on the overall electric field intensity. The results have some guiding significance in the field of lightning protection design of metamaterial.

Author Keywords: Relative position in the same direction

articleTitle: Design of a Printed Monopole Array Antenna with the Simple Feeding Structure
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper introduces an array antenna by use of printed monopole antennas as element. The designed array antenna consists of two layers of dielectric substrate and a metal reflective ground. The array antenna element adopts trapezoidal printed monopole antenna, and the element is fed by coplanar waveguide (CPW).
