The array antenna radiator is located on the top of the upper dielectric substrate, and the feeding microstrip power divider network is located on the bottom of the lower dielectric substrate. The antenna element radiator is vertically connected to the microstrip feeding power divider network in a coaxial-like manner. The whole structure of the antenna is simple, and the feeding structure is convenient, which makes it suitable for fabrication and assembly. A printed 4x4 monopole array antenna was designed and the relevant simulated results are provided. The simulation results show that at the 10GHz, the designed array antenna has a gain of approximately 12.73 dB and a return loss of approximately -11.75 dB. The antenna scheme discussed in this paper can provide technical reference for the design of planar printed array antennas.

articleTitle: Transmission Line Model of EMP Coupling with Star-Quad having Central Reference Conductor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a multiconductor transmission line model is developed for characterizing the coupling of electromagnetic pulse (EMP) with the star-quad cable having a central reference conductor. Expressions for voltages and currents are given for both left and right terminations of the cable. The given model generates the induced common-mode (CM) and differential-mode (DM) currents when the star-quad cable is excited by the EMP. In addition, a comparison is established between the star-quad above the ground plane and the star-quad with the central reference conductor, which shows that in the case of the central reference conductor, the induced CM current is comparatively very less. Also, the radiations for the star-quad with central reference conductor are far less than the star-quad above the ground plane. The results of our proposed model are in good agreement with the results of the commercial software FEKO.

articleTitle: RCS Calculation of Electrically Large Targets on Sea Surface by Iterative MOM-PO Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a hybrid MOM-PO method is proposed to achieve reliable electromagnetic scattering modeling by taking the combination of ship target and reflector array as the analysis target, aiming at the characteristics of the target with strong scattering effect, clutter effect and local coupling. The simulation results show that the proposed method can obtain the relatively accurate calculation results of the scattered field and reduce the huge calculation time requirement for the large unknown quantity loop nesting.

articleTitle: Study on Time-Domain Electromagnetic Response of Coal Seams During Spontaneous Combustion
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, the temperature-frequency-electricity parameter relationship is firstly established, and then the reflection coefficient of the three-layer coal medium is calculated based on the generalized propagation matrix method, and then the variation of the reflected waves of the coal seam medium with the coal temperature is obtained by Fourier transform. The results show that the peak value of the reflected wave decreases first with temperature, then flattens out, and finally increases. The characteristic temperatures of different coal types in the process of spontaneous combustion are given in this paper, which provides a basis for the detection and early warning of coal spontaneous combustion.

articleTitle: A Correction of EMI Prediction Method Based on Interference Margin in DSSS Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: It is necessary to provide methods for performing electromagnetic interference(EMI) predictions when several types of devices operate at the same time. Generally, interference margin quantitatively specifies the interference strength between jammer and victim devices. Designated as fast prediction method, there are some empirical equations in the margin calculation. In some situations of direct spread spectrum system(DSSS), the value of interference margin is inaccurate because of its additional processing gain, taking into account the anti-jamming technique. It may lead to inefficient and inaccurate EMI prediction or even the large difference of interference margin. The focus of this paper is to propose a correction of the conventional prediction method by presenting direct spread transmitting spectrum's effect on the calculation of interference margin and the prediction method, aiming to solve engineering problems. The result shows that the accuracy of EMI margin is improved using correction method in some direct spread spectrum scenarios.

articleTitle: Thinly-Coated Target Scaling Extrapolation Technique Based on Extended GTD Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The basic idea of traditional scaling model measurement method uses electromagnetic similarity relation to realize scaling transformation. The electromagnetic similarity for a scattering problem requires that the electrical size kl remain constant and the target is a perfect electric conducting (PEC) model. In this paper, based on our previous work [8] and the proposed extended GTD (geometric theory of diffraction) model [9], we derive the scaling relation for the thinly-coated targets at the same frequency. The scaling relation is verified by simulation experiment. The results show that the thinly coated models conform to the new scaling relation under certain error conditions.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Extrapolation Solution of Two-dimensional AWE in Broadband and Wide-angle Domains
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$A$</tex> fast solver applied to perfect electric conductors (PEC) is proposed to achieve prediction of monostatic RCS in broadband and wide-angle domains based on two-dimensional asymptotic waveform evaluation (AWE). The combination of the method of moments (MoM) and AWE is used for the prediction of RCS. The current and right vector are considered as binary functions of frequency and angle, the impedance matrix is considered as a function of frequency, and then expanded in a bivariate Taylor series at a given frequency and angle. Furthermore, the expended Taylor series is matched with the two-dimensional Pade approximation to obtain the current, and the required coefficient is calculated. The thought of multiple frequency and angle points unfolding in this paper is applied to improve the accuracy of prediction. Several numerical examples have been proposed to demonstrate the effectiveness of multi-point expansion algorithm.

articleTitle: Measurement Experiments and Data Process for Backscatter Coefficient of Typical Ground Surface in Millimeter Band
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A ground backscatter coefficient measurement system was constructed by combining a robotic arm with a 79GHz millimeter-wave radar. The system utilizes a lift-equipped robotic arm to provide a larger range of incident angles and employs a highly integrated a WR1843 millimeter-wave radar for electro-magnetic scattering measurement. Metal balls were used for cali-bration measurements of scattering amplitude, distance and other factors. After calibrating the measurement data, the scattering coefficient of the measured surfaces can be calculated combined with radar parameters and environmental parameters. Several typical ground surfaces, such as asphalt pavement, anticorrosive wood floor, marble pavement, were measured and the backscatter coefficient curves vs. incident angle were obtained.

articleTitle: Multiscale Decomposition Prediction of Propagation Loss for EM Waves in Marine Evaporation Duct Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The tropospheric duct is an anomalous atmospheric refraction structure in marine environment. Since the propagation loss can reflect the propagation characteristics of EM waves inside the duct layer. A novel multiscale decomposition prediction method (VMD-PSO-LSTM) is proposed in this study. The performance of the VMD-PSO-LSTM method is verified by combining the measured propagation loss. The minimum RMSE and MAE indicators for the VMD-PSO-PSTM method are 0.517 and 0.406, respectively, showing that the VMD-PSO-LSTM method has the advantages of high accuracy and outperforms other comparison methods.

articleTitle: A Switchable Scatterer/Reflector Metasurface for Antenna RCS Reduction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a scatterer and reflector switchable metasurface based on p-i-n diodes for an integrated dipole antenna. The proposed scatter metasurface is constructed based on Pancharatnam-Berry (PB) phase by ordered layout, which can achieve monostatic RCS reduction of the antenna from 3 to 10 GHz. In addition, when the metasurface is switched to the reflector, the integrated dipole antenna can effectively improve the realized gain of the antenna and reduce its profile.

articleTitle: Formation of Transverse Customized Electron Beam for Vortex Smith-Purcell Radiation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The generation of coherent and high-mode purity vortex beams carrying orbital angular momentum can be achieved through Vortex Smith-Purcell radiation from chiral plasmons. However, to selectively excite the chiral plasmons, it is necessary to generate an electron beam with a specific rotational symmetry. In this study, we propose a scheme for an electron gun that can emit an electron beam with transverse rotational symmetry by customizing the emission region of the cathode. The trajectories of the electron beams from the numerical simulations illustrate the feasibility of the proposed scheme. By employing the customized beam, plasmons with a specific topological charge can be alternatively excited and diffracted into coherent vortex free-electron radiations, thereby enabling the development of multi-mode communications and chiral detections in the terahertz band.

articleTitle: Towards the Stable FDTD Subgridding Method with SBP-SAT Technique and Arbitrary Grid Ratio
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A provably stable summation-by-parts simultaneous approximation term (SBP-SAT) finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) subgridding method with arbitrary grid ratios is proposed to solve the transverse magnetic (TM) problems efficiently. The SBP-SAT technique and the carefully designed interpolation matrix with the grid ratio 1:n are used to guarantee long-time stability and accuracy. By introducing a virtual intermediate domain, the interpolation matrix with an arbitrary grid ratio is derived, which is flexible to model complex structures. Numer-ical results show the accuracy, efficiency and flexibility of the proposed subgridding method.

articleTitle: A Neural Network Model for N-Type Metal-Ferroelectric-Insulator-Semiconductor Ferroelectric Tunnel Junction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, we develop an artificial neural network (ANN) model to predict the tunneling current of ferroelectric tunnel junction (FTJ) based on the metal-ferroelectric-insulator-semiconductor (MFIS) stacks using training data obtained from numerical simulation, which calculates tunneling current by the Wentzel-Kramers-Brillouin (WKB) method with the band profile obtained by self-consistently solving Poisson's equations and the drift-diffusion transport equations with a tunneling-induced carrier generation rate. The proposed ANN model can greatly reduce simulation cost while maintaining high accuracy, showing good agreement with both numerical simulation results and experiment results.

articleTitle: A Single-Source Surface Integral Methods for Analysis of Dielectric Objects
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Traditional surface integral methods require both of equivalent electric current and magnetic current for calculating the scattering of dielectric objects. This paper proposes a method that needs a single current, which is using the differential surface admittance operator. Compared to the Poggio-Miller-Chang-Harrington-Wu-Tsai (PMCHWT) method, the number of unknowns is only half of the PMCHWT formulation, and it requires only a quarter of the memory consumption of the PMCHWT equation. In terms of numerical verification, the method has been improved with BC (Buffa-Christiansen) basis functions and the accuracy has been verified.

articleTitle: Isolation Enhancement Between Closely Spaced Patch Antennas Using Capacitively-loaded-loop Spiral-shaped Split Rectangular Rings
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a capacitively-loaded-loop spiral-shaped split rectangular rings (CLLs) loaded between two close-range multi-input multi-output (MIMO) antenna elements is proposed to improve their isolation. By carefully adjusting the basic parameters of the CLLs decoupling structure, the equivalent capacitance and inductance are changed to cancel the coupling between the antenna elements. The results show that when the center distance of MIMO antenna elements is about 0.34λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>, the mutual coupling can be reduced by more than 24 dB.

articleTitle: Forward Modelling of Complex Target Scattering Centers with Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)

articleTitle: A Hybrid Method for Scattering from Conductor Objects
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)

articleTitle: SSPP-Based mmWave Array Antenna Design Based on MSAO Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents the use of a Multi-Surrogate-Assisted Optimization (MSAO) framework to design and optimize two spoof surface plasmon polariton (SSPP) transmission line (TL) fed mmWave array antennas. The framework is aimed at simultaneously optimizing multiple design objectives such as S-parameters, gain, pattern, main lobe direction (MLD), and side lobe level (SLL). The SSPP transmission line fed array antenna has a complex design space with more than 30 variables, including the size and position of the circular patch. The first SSPP-TL-fed array antenna among the two fabricated antennas is capable of SLL less than -21.5 dB for both 27 and 28 GHz. The second antenna is designed to reduce the SLL in a given direction while maintaining the main lobe direction. The measurement results show the MLD at -2°, with the null at 35°.

articleTitle: Hot-Carrier Injection Degradation of 1.8V nMOSFET and a New Predication Model Based on LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The hot-carrier injection (HCI) degradation mechanism of 1.8V n-channel metal-oxide semiconductor field-effect transistor (nMOSFET) is studied, and the degradation tendency of the saturated drain current (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$I$</tex><inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">dsat</inf>) under different gate bias stresses is shown. Combining with the experimental data, a neural network model based on the long short-term memory (LSTM) for predicting the behavior of the HCI degradation is trained and tested. The model reaches a fairly good predictive ability (R2 = 0.974 and mean absolute error = 0.06686). The degradation rate δI<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">dsat</inf>(t) from 0% to 6% is successfully used to predict the remaining degradation process until 10% shift of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$I$</tex><inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">dsat</inf>(t) based on the model, which can obviously decrease the testing time and labor cost.

articleTitle: A Three-Dimensional SBP-SAT FDTD Method for Complex Structures
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The FDTD method has been widely used in practical applications. This method shows limitations when deal with multiscale structures. Although the subgridding techniques provide an efficient solution by locally refining meshes, stability issues appear during long-time simulations. This paper proposes a three SBP-SAT FDTD method for long-time stability, which employs staggered grids and few mesh changes. A cavity and an aircraft are simulated by the proposed method and the conventional FDTD method. Both computational resource consumption and accuracy of the proposed method are compared with the FDTD method.

articleTitle: A Compact Multi-Band MIMO Antenna for UAV Communications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presented a multi-band conformal MIMO antenna for unmanned aerial vehicles. The antenna is composed of four equally-sized mutually orthogonal meta-material radiating elements, a center-fed decoupling structure with a resonant aperture ring, and a back cross dumbbell-shaped structure. Simulated results show that the antenna operates in four frequency bands (2.07 GHz-2.84 GHz, 4.89 GHz-6.99 GHz, 8.19 GHz-9.10 GHz, 10.22 GHz-11.19 GHz), with a maximum gain of up to 3 dBi and a highest isolation of −54 dB. The overall size of the antenna is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$71.1\times 71.1\ \mathrm{m}^{2}$</tex>, and the dielectric substrate is made of flexible polyimide material with a thickness of 0.13 mm, allowing the antenna to be conformal to the UAV body. This antenna can be widely used in UAV communications, 5G communications, and IoT.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic-Thermal Multiphysical Modeling of Substrate Integrated Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Substrate integrated waveguides (SIWs) have many advantages and have been widely used in microwave circuits. As the integration density and the interconnection complexity of microwave circuits increases, the thermal effects no longer be ignored This paper introduces a multiphysical numerical technique based on the finite element method (FEM) to solve the electromagnetic-thermal effect of SIWs. The FEM can effectively simulate the steady and transient response of electromagnetic and thermal fields and can flexibly adapt to material properties, making it efficient for the analysis of electromagnetic-thermal problems in microwave devices.

articleTitle: Recent advances in automated multilayer ANN model generation for microwave components
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Automated model generation (AMG) is recognized as an efficient method to automatically develop artificial neural network (ANN) models for microwave components. It replaces the complicated manual operations during ANN modeling with a completely automated ANN development framework, thus effectively improving the ANN modeling efficiency. In this paper, a recent advanced AMG method combining interpolation techniques and multilayer neural model structure adaptation is presented and a microwave cavity filter modeling example is used to demonstrate the effectiveness of presented method.

articleTitle: Engineering Foundation Reinforcement Detection Using Joint Inversion of Electromagnetic and Seismic Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Quantitative detection of the distribution of water, air and porosity is helpful to evaluate the stability analysis of foundation reinforcement treatment. As a simple and nondestructive evaluation technology, geophysical prospecting is widely applied in foundation reinforcement treatment. However, the evaluation of stability analysis used single inversion is away under non-uniqueness and ill-pose. In this paper, we use the joint inversion of seismic refraction data and resistivity data to calculate the content of water, air, porosity and other components in the stratum during foundation reinforcement treatment. Numerical case studies are presented and demonstrated the effectiveness of this joint inversion in quantitative detection of foundation reinforcement treatment.

articleTitle: An Improved ISRJ Based on Micro-Doppler Modulation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The false targets generated by traditional interrupted sampling repeater jamming (ISRJ) are evenly distributed in the radar echo range dimension and the power attenuation of the leading and lagging false target groups is fast, so they are easy to be eliminated by radar. To address the above problems, an ISRJ technique based on micro Doppler Modulation (mDM-ISRJ) is proposed. We establish a theoretical model for adding micro Doppler modulation to ISRJ and analyze the interference effect of mDM-ISRJ through simulation experiments. The results show that the proposed mDM-ISRJ can generate “surface” interference effect, and the amplitude of false target follows the Swerling fluctuation characteristic consistent with the real target, effectively improving the jamming efficiency of ISRJ.

articleTitle: Anisotropic Lumped Network Model for Electric Properties of Heterogeneous Media
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Heterogeneous media are prevalent in natural and engineering settings, such as fractured rock, layered geological formations, and multiscale subsurface environments. The accuracy of remote sensing data inversion is heavily influenced by media heterogeneity. The electrical properties of saturated fractured networks, which consist of a less conductive solid matrix and a conductive brine in the pore space, have many applications in petrophysics and reservoir engineering. Currently, most upscaling models of rock pore structure assume a homogeneous medium, which fails to accurately reflect the pore or fissure structure in the rock. The lumped network (LN) model establishes the relationship between effective resistivity and fracture/pore phases. In this study, we developed an anisotropic LN model for a two-dimensional rock model based on the pore classification method. We transformed the volume of isotropic and anisotropic pores in the two-dimensional rock model into resistances in the LN. Our proposed method demonstrated an improvement in equivalent accuracy for both non-fractured and fractured media compared to the classic model.

articleTitle: A Genetic-Algorithm-Based In-Situ Diagnostic Method for Plasma with Non-Uniform Distribution Profile
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The plasma sheath generated during the re-entry process of the hypersonic aircraft has a great impact on the electromagnetic radiation, transmission, and scattering problems. In this paper, an in-situ diagnostic method for non-uniformly distributed plasma sheath is proposed based on microwave reflection theory. Using the genetic algorithm, the electron density distribution and collision frequency of the plasma can be inferred from a set of broadband complex reflection coefficients. To mitigate the challenge of the multiple values in the inverse problem, an additional dimension of information can be involved into the reflection coefficients. Specifically, introducing static magnetic fields with varying intensities can help improve the inversion accuracy and robustness. Numerical experiment involving the diagnosis of a typical plasma profile subjected to double Gauss distribution demonstrate the accuracy and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: High On-body Efficiency Antenna Design
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This article presents a novel mobile phone antenna design that boasts high efficiency and is tailored for the B42 frequency band of LTE. By strategically adjusting the radiation pattern of the antenna, the negative impact of human tissue on mobile phone performance is effectively mitigated. As a result, the overall user experience is greatly enhanced.

articleTitle: A Novel Wideband Antenna Design for Metal Frame Smartphones
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper presents a new antenna structure for metal frame smartphones. The structure does not require clearance on the ground plane and uses an IFA with parasitic branches to extend the bandwidth. Compared with traditional metal antennas, this antenna has the advantages of wide bandwidth, high efficiency, and uniform current distribution, making it a promising candidate for smartphone antennas.

articleTitle: Design of A Wideband Metasurface Antenna using Characteristic Mode Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A wideband metasurface antenna is designed by using characteristic mode analysis (CMA). The proposed metasuface is formed by a 7×7 square patches nonuniform array. Based on the characteristic mode analysis, the proposed metasurface is designed by arranging larger patches at the inner row and smaller patches at the outmost row, having a tapering configuration. The metasurface is excited by using a capacitive coupling excitation of a probe-fed circular patch, a wideband is achieved by combing two resonances of the metasurface and patch modes. The simulate results show that, the proposed metasurface antenna has an impedance bandwidth of 43.6% and a good omnidirectional pattern in horizontal plane.

articleTitle: A circular substrate-integrated waveguide bandpass filter with controllable transmission zeros
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Herein, a substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) bandpass filter with three transmission zeros is proposed. The filter comprises two semicircular SIW cavities and a circular SIW cavity. This design enabling the propagation modes in different resonant cavities to be cross-coupled to generate transmission zeros and can be flexibly designed within a certain range. Based on this, a bandpass filter with a center frequency of 7.7 GHz was fabricated. The measured data of the vector network analyzer showed that the 3-dB bandwidth of the filter was 205 MHz, the return loss in the passband was less than 20 dB, the out-of-band rejection effect was good, and there were three transmission zeros on both sides of the passband (6.7, 9.6 and 11.6 GHz). The feasibility of the design was verified.

articleTitle: Microstrip-Photonic Topological Insulators converter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a topological converter is designed to achieve efficient transition between traditional microstrip line and Photonic Topological Insulators(PTIs). To realize this, the Bloch impedance of the target PTIs is obtained using a periodic structure impedance extraction method, which serves as a guide in the converter's design process. A comparative analysis with existing conversion structure is performed, revealing that the proposed topological converter exhibits superior coupling performance. The device is fabricated and extensively tested, with excellent agreement between experimental and simulation results observed. These promising results suggest significant potential for practical applications of the designed topological converter in the field of PTIs.

articleTitle: Test and Analysis of Electromagnetic Radiation Immunity Tests of New Digital Instrumentation and Control Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In nuclear power plants, the instrumentation and control system is the central brain of the nuclear power plant, ensuring the safe and stable operation of the plant by performing measurements and controls. The instrumentation and control system is currently being fully digitally integrated. This is accompanied by the corresponding electromagnetic compatibility issues. In order to achieve early warning monitoring of the electromagnetic environment in the instrumentation and control room, it is first necessary to carry out sensitive experiments on the equipment used and to obtain electromagnetically sensitive data. We have therefore carried out electromagnetic sensitivity experiments on new instrumentation and control equipment to obtain the corresponding sensitivity mechanisms and to provide data support for the later construction of the early warning system, which has certain engineering significance.

articleTitle: Permeability Estimation Using Tensor Based on Critical Path Analysis for Anisotropy Media
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Permeability is a crucial factor in oil and gas exploration and development, as it indicates a reservoir's ability to flow. To predict permeability from electrical exploration results, Critical Path Analysis (CPA) is commonly used by combining reservoir permeability and electrical conductivity. However, the accuracy of CPA decreases when unconventional reservoirs exhibit strong anisotropy, such as fractured shales. This study presents tensor-based CPA methods that utilize equivalent electrical parameters and permeability tensor to address this issue. The approach involves obtaining critical pore radius and permeability in tensor form through matrix operation. The accuracy of the CPA formula in calculating reservoir permeability is then compared with numerical simulation results. The findings indicate that the tensor-based CPA method significantly improves the permeability prediction accuracy of anisotropic media, and further improvements can be made using the revised tensor-based CPA.

articleTitle: Angular Glint Calculation Based on Forward Attributed Scattering Center Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The angular glint calculation formulations are derived based on forward attributed scattering center models. By using the phase gradient method (PGM), triple sphere model and SLICY model are proposed and simulated. By compared with high frequency method, numerical results shows that it is feasible to realize angular glint based on forward scattering center model.

articleTitle: Decoupling of Dual-Port Stacked Patch Antenna Using Characteristic Mode Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this work, a self-decoupling technique is proposed based on the theory of characteristic modes. By inspecting the coupled energy of each characteristic mode and suppressing the ones with large coupling coefficients, the isolations between antennas are greatly improved. To validate the approach, two stacked antennas at the same 5G Wi-Fi band are decoupled. After analyzing the modes of the upper and the lower patches, slots were etched at specific positions on the antennas, without affecting the original radiation modes. As a result, the isolations between antennas are improved from 10 dB to 15 dB, without any additional decoupling structure. The proposed method is applicable to various kinds of antennas.

articleTitle: A Ku-Band Filtering LNA with Flat Gain and High Linearity
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper introduces a low-noise amplifier (LNA) capable of covering the entire Ku band with filtering function and good linearity. This paper uses a feedback circuit based on coupling line structure to compensate for the gain roll-off of the transistor. The coupling line in the feedback structure is also used to realize the filter function of the low noise amplifier. A multigate transistor structure (MGTR) based on the derivative superposition (DS) principle to improve the intermodulation distortion of the low noise amplifier. The amplifier has an average gain of 24dB, a noise figure of 1.5dB and an IIP3 of 6dBm. To further enhance the filtering characteristics of the amplifier within the 14-15 GHz frequency range, this paper presents the design of a dielectric waveguide bandpass filter based on Ferro-A6M material, achieving band interpolation loss less than 0.8dB, low-end out-of-band 30MHz attenuation reaches 23.6dB, high-end out-of-band 100MHz attenuation reaches 47dB. The HFSS model of this filter was imported into ADS for system-level cascaded simulations, resulting in excellent rectangular coefficient and out-of-band suppression.

articleTitle: A Low-Profile Broadband Dual-Polarized Omnidirectional Antenna with Low Gain Variations for 5G Indoor Mobile Communications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A low-profile broadband dual-polarized omnidirectional antenna with low gain variations (GV) for 5G indoor mobile communications is presented. A vertical-polarized (VP) antenna element is composed of a pair of orthogonal conical plates and a top-loaded circular brass disc to broaden the impedance bandwidth. A horizontal-polarized (HP) element is consisted of four printed dipoles with rectangular etched slot and parasitic patches around the dipoles to broaden the operating bandwidth, and a 1-to-4 power divider feeding network on the bottom. The feeding network with the balun of “T”-shaped with terminated shorting-circuit via to improve the isolation between the VP and HP elements. Two pairs of extending strips printed along the ±45° direction are used to reduce the GV and broaden the impedance bandwidth. The antenna achieves a compact size of 110mm*110mm*40mm, and the height is only 0.26λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">min</inf>(λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">min</inf> which is the free-space wavelength at the minimum operating frequency). The overlapped bandwidth of 76% (1.69-3.75GHz) with an excellent port isolation (> 28dB) is achieved. Satisfactory omnidirectional radiation characteristics are obtained for both the VP and the HP elements, the GV of the VP element is less than 2 dB, and the GV of the HP element is less than 2.5 dB.

articleTitle: Research on Linear EBG Structure for E-Plane Coupling Suppression of Microstrip Array
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The strong coupling between antenna units not only affects the performance of antenna units, but also has a very adverse impact on the performance of antenna arrays. Research on coupling suppression between antenna units is of great significance and practical value for antenna array design. A novel electromagnetic bandgap structure which is composed of double L-shaped resonant cell is proposed to effectively suppress the coupling between microstrip antenna units on the E-plane without changing the structure of the antenna array. The current distribution of defected ground is introduced to explain the principle of coupling suppression. Detailed analysis of current and performance parameters proves that the resonant structure has a strong ability to suppress the coupling between antenna units and also has a good robustness.

articleTitle: Prediction of Stochastic Properties of Low-Frequency Sky-Wave in the Earth-Ionosphere Waveguide Based on the S-FDTD Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This letter focuses on the prediction of low-frequency (LF) wave propagation characteristics in the Earth-ionosphere waveguide under complex and stochastic ionospheric conditions. Based on the stochastic finite-difference time-domain (S-FDTD) method of a single simulation, we construct a hierarchical numerical model of LF wave propagation under isotropic stochastic ionosphere conditions. The Monte Carlo FDTD (MC-FDTD) method and the wave-hop theory are respectively used to compare the statistical characteristics of the sky-wave obtained by the S-FDTD method under short-range or long-range conditions. The effectiveness and efficiency of the S-FDTD method are verified, which can quickly measure the time-domain uncertainty of the LF sky-wave mode in the complex and stochastic Earth-ionosphere waveguide.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Numerical Modeling of Optical Radiation Pressure Force Exerted on Multimer Objects
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Numerical modeling and simulation play an important role in the prediction and analysis of optical radiation pressure force (RPF). However, the structural complexity of multimer objects will increase the computational complexity. In this paper, an efficient numerical modeling method based on the finite element method (FEM) and the fast compressed matrix algorithm is developed to analyze optical radiation pressure force. For nano multimer objects, it has been verified that the algorithm proposed in this paper has shorter computational time, compared with traditional iterative solving methods.

articleTitle: Complete Decoupling of a Close Patch Antenna Pair by Manipulating the Mode Conductance with Patch Trimming
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This article presents a design for closely spaced patch antenna pair with high isolation. Firstly, through characteristic mode analysis (CMA), it is shows that decoupling with loading inductance alone is incomplete. Then, a decoupling scheme of trimming the patch is proposed for the conductive coupling between antennas. By changing the trimming size, it is possible to equalize the mode conductance of the odd and even modes of the patch antenna pair, thereby achieving complete decoupling. Finally, the feasibility of this scheme is verified through full-wave simulation, and the antenna achieves up to 26.75 dB isolation at a working frequency of 2.45 GHz.

articleTitle: Robust Inverse Design of Microwave Limiter Based on Feature Extraction and Noise Injection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Inverse design based on response data to infer limiter design parameters is crucial for the electromagnetic pulse (EMP) protection of circuit boards. However, inverse design is challenging due to it being a non-convex optimization problem in a high-dimensional space. This study addresses the limiter inverse design problem using feature extraction and data augmentation based on noise injection. The proposed method enhances the model's training by introducing noise, significantly boosting the robustness and performance of the model. Differing from traditional methods requiring multiple characteristic curves, the proposed method can provide accurate prediction by only a single burnout time and temperature curve. The comparison with other machine learning methods proves the significance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Broadband RCS Reduction Based on Simple Chessboard Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: A simple chessboard metasurface consisting of only one type of cell is proposed. The unit of metasurface can achieve a phase difference of 180°±37° at 9.3-30.6 GHz. The metasurface can achieve more than 10 dB of RCS reduction at 9.1-31.7 GHz. The metasurface still has excellent RCS reduction capability when irradiated by 30° oblique incident polarization waves.

articleTitle: Transient Electromagnetic-Thermal Simulation of Dispersive Media Using HIE-FDTD Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: The transient electromagnetic-thermal co-simulation of dispersive media based on hybrid implicit explicit finite difference time domain (HIE- FDTD) method is studied in this paper. Both the frequency-dependent and temperature-dependent properties of dispersive media are taken into account during the modeling process. A numerical example is performed to demonstrate its effectiveness by comparing with conventional FDTD and COMSOL.

articleTitle: An Efficient Computational Model for Scattering Properties of Multilayer Anisotropic Composites
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: This paper aims to build an efficient and robust computational model for electromagnetic scattering properties of multilayer anisotropic composites based on scattering matrix method. Comparing to previous work, it has better stability and is suitable for arbitrary anisotropic materials, including magnetic materials. Through this computational model, the reflectance and transmittance can be calculated, and the field distribution in multilayer anisotropic composites can be obtained. The correctness of the computational model is verified by comparing the calculation results with the simulation results from lab-developed FDTD code.

articleTitle: A Millimeter-Wave Filtering Magneto-Electric Dipole Antenna Based on SIW Feed
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: In this paper, a millimeter-wave filtering magneto-electric dipole antenna based on SIW feed is proposed, which cancels out the current distribution on the surface of the patch by etching symmetrical gaps on the four patches, thereby generating a gain zero in a higher frequency band. A symmetrical double U-slot etched in the ground under the SIW cavity impedes current transmission, creating an additional gain zero at high frequencies. Due to the high-pass characteristics of the SIW resonator itself, there will be good gain selectivity at out-of-band low frequencies. The proposed millimeter wave filtering antenna has the characteristic of wide bandwidth, small size and good filtering effect. The simulation results show that the -10dB impedance bandwidth of the antenna is 21% <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(23.91\sim 29.57 \ \text{GWz})$</tex>, the out-of-band rejection level is greater than 13dB, the average in-band realized gain is 6.55dBi, and the peak realized gain is 7.46 dBi, covering the n257 and n258 frequency bands in 5G communication.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Matrix-Based Direct Solver for Permuted Poggio-Miller-Chang-Harrington-Wu-Tsai Equation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: With some rearrangement of the basis and testing functions, a permuted impedance matrix of the Poggio- Miller-Chang-Harrington-Wu-Tsai (PMCHWT) equation is obtained, where the canonical hierarchical matrix-based direct solver can effectively function. In this paper, the feasibility of hierarchical matrix schemes in permuted PMCHWT is derived. Compared with using four hierarchical matrices on four submatrices in the classic formula, the method using hierarchical matrices on the permuted formula can reduce both the memory of storage and the time of decomposition. Several numerical results are provided to validate the permutation combined with the hierarchical matrix and to reveal the efficiency and accuracy of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable Spatial Power Dividers Using Phase-Amplitude Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2023 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium (ACES-China)
abstract: Reconfigurable multi-beam manipulation is essential for high-capacity communications, yet is still challenging and in its infancy. Here, we employed a double-arc resonator loaded with two kinds of PIN diodes to realize spin-symmetry breaking. An addition theorem of complex reflection coefficients is presented to acquire flexible multi-beam control with arbitrary intensity and direction. For demonstration, a proof-of-concept metasurface is devised and numerically characterized at 5.35 GHz, exhibiting distinct multi-beam radiation with flexible strengths and directions. Our finding of reconfigurable spatial power dividers would be vital for multi-beam radar systems and set up a solid platform for arbitrary reconfigurable devices with simultaneous phase and amplitude modulations.
